name: Tropical Canopy Guest Studio in Hawaii
description: Welcome to the Puna forest! Cute and cozy, the Canopy Studio is the perfect place to relax and let go. Located on a quiet dead end street. One mile to Kehena Beach, six miles to the new Po'hoiki Black Sand Beach & naturally heated pools. Visit the many tide pools along the red road.  Enjoy the exquisite hardwood kitchen and matching furniture made from the Monkey Pod tree. The Studio is a great place to decompress.
neighborhood_overview: Ten minute walk to the black sand beach of Kehena, where there may be dolphins to play with. A short drive will land you at Unlce Roberts Kava bar, where you will often find the Uncles playing old Hawaiian country songs on Wednesday night. Also, at Uncle Roberts is the Saturday morning farmers market.
host_about:
Aloha, I made a lifestyle decision to move to Hawaii in 2005. I fell in love with the Big Island for the first time in 97. Since then I've explored homesteading and a closer connection to our land. I have been building and creating. Now I am ready to share the house with travelers who visit this magical place. I am into a peaceful sustainable existence, that gives rest to a fast moving civilization. Sometimes it is enough to just look at the stars, and here you can see them well, or just return to the original TV, a nice relaxing fire. And I love to cook on the flames, so simple, so good. Sharing food is my favorite form of communion. I love slow cooking, whether it be smoking or stew making. Slower and longer is just better if you ask me. 

I am a builder, and as a builder the most gratifying thing is to see people enjoying the manifestations that have been created. Sometimes the focus of what it means to construct something for the utilitarian purpose gets lost in the process. But, the magic is always underlying everything, so many times pure serendipity is right there, reminding us. The intention is everything and construed in all the stones carried, wood carved, land sculpted and much, much else. When the energy is pure, then it is easily conveyed or felt. This land is unfolding as the volcano has taught us. All who become part of this history will see how powerful is the asking. My experience here is that there is an instant reflection in the asking. Have fun and come and see...After all this is some of the newest land on this planet.

name: OCEANVIEW 3 or 4BR Princeville- The Cliffs Resort!
description:
Huge unit with four balconies and ocean view; we often see whales right from the balcony! Our shared ownership condo is at a beautiful Princeville resort with pool, Jacuzzi, playground, tennis courts, on site tour desk, and bar b q pavilions, nearby golf.

Pricing is for 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, 8 persons. The adjacent bedroom and bath which has an optional separate entry is available for only $50 more per night. The 4/4 option will sleep up to 10.
neighborhood_overview: Kaui is the most beautiful and untouched of all the Islands... we have stayed here in our unit many times, with adults, with kids, with teens, and we never run out of things to do. For the adventurous, we've been ziplining, have hiked the Na Pali coast (absolutely the most stunning vistas anywhere!), have taken surfing lessons, gone scuba diving, sky diving, hiked to waterfalls, horseback riding, ATV tours, canoes, kayaks, and have ventured into true wilderness of astounding beauty. The 75+ movies that have been shot here give a good idea of the rugged beauty here... Jurassic Park, for example. We are close to world class golf (2 or 3 courses, including a great public course with beautiful views), tennis, and we are very close to Hanalei. Hanalei is a must see- with it's beautiful beaches, taro fields,and charming town and restaurants. We never tire of this Island; it is the least inhabited yet seems to have the most to do!
host_about: In our spare time we like to  travel, enjoy our friends and family, and take in sporting events. Janice likes to play tennis and is a horse lover. Janice's husband  plays golf when he can, and is a big baseball fan.

host_about:
We live in a little town called Helen, Georgia. Helen is a unique Bavarian-style tourist town, where we are lucky enough to run tourist activities year round. My wife and I are ordained ministers and we have a business called On the River Weddings and we help couples make their dreams come true with lovely events in our classic little chapel on the banks of the Chattahoochie River.
When we first bought our little condo in Hawaii, it was simply a place to get away for a little R and R in the winters. We came to love the little town of Makaha, Oahu, and when we learned about Airbnb, we realized it would be a great way to share our feelings about the place and help people realize their dreams of coming to Hawaii for a vacation or a honeymoon in an affordable way. We hope you share our feelings about this special place after hiking in the Makaha Valley, swimming, surfing or just sunbathing at Makaha Beach, and reveling in our gorgeous sunsets! Aloha and we hope to see ya soon!

The Waikoloa Beach Resort is very family and pedestrian friendly. Most properties are within a 10-15 minute walk (3-5minute drive with ample parking) to ʻAnaehoʻomalu Bay, also known as A-Bay. Other nearby historical sites include lava caves where people took shelter during conflicts, plus a spot where a decisive battle was fought between ruling factions (well worth taking the time to check these out).

neighborhood_overview:
Puamana is located just one mile south of Old Lahaina Town, easily accessible by foot, bike or car. You can visit the wonderful restaurants, shops, clubs, Gelato or Shave Ice spots easily from your town home.
The surfing on the property is some of the best on the island, known as "Pools" and is for intermediate and up.
There are many family friendly beaches nearby (see our document on beaches) as the West side of Maui is the best location to travel to all of the highlights of the island.

Family Favorites and Beach Recommendations:

Our snorkeling tips:
On the West side of Maui we think Honolua Bay is the best. Drive north on 30 about 1 1/3 miles north of DT Fleming Park. Parking is sketchy right off the main road. If you continue another 8/10s of a mile you can turn left and drive along the road to watch the surfers just beyond Honolua Bay. The beach is rocky, not good for sunbathing, but the snorkeling is fabulous and the turtles are pretty active
host_about:
Dave and Cheryl fell in love with Puamana on their first visit. Although we also love beautiful Half Moon Bay, we anticipate getting away from it all to Maui as often as possible. 
Our goal is for our guests to enjoy their stay on island as much as we do so we strive to make each visit the best possible. 
We love to stare at the ocean, smell the Plumeria, and enjoy fresh fish and mangoes all day long. Occasionally take a daring adventure by ocean or up country to the mountains. 
We have never tired of the beauty and pure serenity of Puamana, we hope you will try it and fall in love as well.

As business travelers we have had the opportunity to visit some of the most amazing cities but none of these locations have come close to the feeling of peace and serenity that we have found in Wailea. Grand Champions Villas is hands down the greatest value in all of Wailea. The central location, beautifully maintained grounds, security and space within the villas cannot be beat. The villa is perfected by a truly beautiful interior with a fresh, relaxing vibe. It was our goal to bring the beauty we saw in the grounds of Wailea to the interior of the villa where we spend time with our family creating cherished memories. We would love to share this magical place with you. Hula On In to Beach House Chic Style. With warmest aloha, Paul

neighborhood_overview:
Although our property offers seclusion and quietness, you can find great restaurants and grocery shopping just a 6-minute drive away. If you are into organic and healthy foods, the Mana Foods store in Paia is just 10 minutes away, and the Pauwela Cannery is perfect for casual breakfast or lunch. The Haiku Cannery has even more dining options, including Nuka Sushi and Colleen's Restaurant for burgers, pizza, and more. Vegout offers vegetarian options, and Maui Kombucha Bar is a must-visit. Don't forget to check out the Ahonui Plant-Based Cafe food truck on 111 Stable Road, Paia.

If you're here during wave season, make sure to visit Jaws to witness some of the biggest rideable waves on the planet. For hikers and adventurers, the Makawao Forest offers a unique hiking experience, and Piiholo Ranch Zip Line is a must-try. Stop by Makawao Town for shopping and sandwiches at Casanova's, or head to Paia for a stroll on the beach and some shopping at Mana Foods.

The Gold Coast is the last strip of buildings at the end of Kalakaua Ave. across from Kapiolani Park. Unlike the “hustle and bustle” of Waikiki, the Gold Coast is a little more quiet.Right out the front doors of these buildings offer great swimming, diving, and surfing breaks such as Tongg’s, Rice Bowls, Old Man’s, and several others. You’ve also got Kapiolani Park on the Mauka (mountain side) as I mentioned, which is a great spot for outdoor activities and the finish line for the Honolulu Marathon, the Tinman Triathlon, etc.

Also the Diamond Head Beach Hotel is less than 2 buildings away from Private Clubs such as the Elk’s Club and the Outrigger Canoe Club.

Aolani Coffee Cottage: A Tranquil Sanctuary in the Heart of Hawaii

Welcome to Aolani Coffee Cottage, an enchanting retreat nestled among the lush coffee farms of Holualoa and only a 10 minute drive from the stunning Magic Sands Beach.. Here, serenity abounds, offering you a haven to rest, recharge, and reconnect with the beauty of Hawaii. neighborhood_overview:
Java is the juice that powers Holualoa, the little village and art enclave in the heart of Kona coffee country. This is a great place to taste the rich flavors of 100% pure Kona coffee, a rare commodity exclusively grown in north and south Kona. There are many great restaurants within just a few miles such as Rebel Kitchen, Magics Grill and Kaya's.

The high elevation, constant cloud coverage, and rich volcanic soil in the upland slopes of Kona, Holualoa and Kealakekua create an ideal environment for harvesting the unique Kona coffee bean. There are roughly 600 coffee farms in the Kona area and many offer tours to the public. Visit Holualoa’s thriving coffee orchards and learn about the meticulous harvesting process. Then explore the coffee mill and see how the beans are processed. As you finish your tour, sip a freshly brewed cup for yourself and experience the rich aroma and flavor that makes 100% Kona coffee so highly valued.

neighborhood_overview:
Waikīkī is a beachfront neighborhood of Honolulu, on the south shore of the island of Oʻahu, in Hawaii, United States. Waikīkī is best known for Waikīkī Beach, "a tourism mecca to both east and west creating a vibrant energy mixed with Hawaiian spirit."
The name Waikīkī means spouting fresh water in the Hawaiian language, for springs and streams that fed wetlands that once separated Waikīkī from the interior.
The area was a retreat for Hawaiian royalty in the 1800s who enjoyed surfing there on early forms of longboards.
A few small hotels opened in the 1880s.
Today, the area is filled with large resort hotels, such as the Hilton Hawaiian Village and the Sheraton Waikiki, and historic hotels dating back to the early 20th century (such as the Moana Surfrider Hotel and the Royal Hawaiian Hotel).
The beach hosts many events a year, including surf competitions, outdoor performances, hula dancing and outrigger canoe races.
-via Wikipedia

description: Come enjoy the relaxed tropical setting of this ocean-view two-bedroom, two-bath condo. Located in sunny Poipu, you will be minutes away from some of the best beaches Kauai has to offer.
neighborhood_overview: Poʻipū Beach Park is located in the community of Poʻipū on the southern coast of Kauaʻi island in Hawaii. The beach is a park has lifeguards provided by the county of Kauaʻi.
host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

host_about:
I am a lover of warm weather, sunshine, water & sandy beaches. When I travel, I prefer to live like a local .. which is why AirBnB holds so much appeal to me & why I have decided to take on the role of AirBnB Host. I love to adventure around the places I visit .. looking for those tucked away spots favored by locals & tourists alike. Once I find a place I love, I can hardly wait to share it with others. 

My husband & I own a small restaurant called St. Tropez Bistro, (IG: @sainttropezbistroyxe), with an even smaller hidden cocktail bar called Parlor, (IG: @parloryxe), on our 2nd floor. Our small businesses are located inside a beautiful old heritage building at the center of our city’s  busy downtown entertainment district. I believe that it is the reason why we often find our adventuring to be driven by a quest for thoughtful food, fun drink & a great wine list. We love to support locally owned businesses .. little hidden gems, found off the beaten path are the places we frequent the most .. if they use locally sourced ingredients, even better! 

Between Jason and I, we have over 30+ years of experience working in the hospitality/service industry .. we understand the importance of building & maintaining lasting relationships with our guests. I often say that our restaurant & cocktail bar feel like an extension of our home .. making guests feel welcome, comfortable & relaxed is always our number one goal. Now, we are expanding on that mantra by opening up our Waikiki ‘Home Away From Home’ for others to enjoy as much as we do.

description:
Beach front condo at Kahalu'u Beach (Turtle Beach) with incredible Ocean and Sunset views. Swimming, snorkeling, surfing, & tide pool directly across street. Off street parking, infinity pool, lava rock spa & barbecue area with tables, chairs, umbrellas and lounge chairs in condo complex.

Shopping and restaurants (including famous Sam Choy's Kai Lanai) are all within a short distance, making our condo a comfortable home away from home.

Central Air optional at $20 extra per night plus tax.
neighborhood_overview:
Across street from the condo is the stop for the open air trolley running every hour to the pier and into town where a variety of stores, restaurants and bars are located. Along the way are beaches and fantastic vistas. The Sheraton hosts the Giant Manta Rays show every night. After dinner and the show, guests may catch the convenient trolley back to the condo.

Kayaks can be rented at $40 per day at Keauheous Bay which is within walking distance from the condo. Boats trips to nearby famous snorkeling/diving spots like Captain Cook and City of Refuge are offered at docks within 1/2 mile of the condo .

Guests will love the morning or evening strolls along beautiful Alii Drive. There are so many little coves and areas where one can just walk out on smooth lava rocks in between homes and take in the gorgeous views.
host_about:
My family lives in Laguna Beach, Southern California.   My wife and I enjoy strolling along the beach taking in the fresh air and watching the beautiful seascape.  My three sons are avid surfers and bogey boarders.  They are out there catching the waves whenever they have a free moment.

Despite the surf and sand in California, we vacation in the Big Island of Hawaii frequently because of the bluer and warmer water, the greener and lusher vegetation, the colorful tropical fish and the longer riding waves.  Besides, we have many cousins throughout the Hawaii Island.  

My son jumped at the opportunity of buying this unit together with a friend when it became available in early 2014.  We enjoy the snorkeling and the surfing across street from the condo so much that we just bought another unit in this small beach front complex when it became available.  We now have two adjacent units at this favorite spot of ours in Hawaii to which the entire family can return together every year --- we never get tired of it.

host_about:
I have lived in Maui for 11 years. The last 3 years I have shared my time between Maui and Washington State, and so I have my home on Airbnb when I am not on Island.

I have gone through FOUR Housekeeping Services since I started renting out My Home almost 3 years ago, as you can see by reviews the first 3 were very inconsistent.  As far as the Cleaning and re-stocking fee, that is the going rate on the Island and it is what they charge. I did not set the fee.
I have added air conditioning to the bedroom, Maui has seen record temperatures in the last year and it is now needed.
The wifi is not shared and I pay for the best the Island has. Which by the way can be sketchy depending on the weather, just a part of Island life. :-).
Lastly, please remember that this in My Home. The condo was renovated approximately 6 years ago, but I am still working on things here and there. Some of the furnishings were given to me by family members or have meaning to me, so I hope you appreciate this aspect of the uniqueness Airbnb has to offer.
Maui is a Beautiful, Amazing, Loving and (expensive) Paradise!! Sharing My Ohana and giving people a chance to experience the Island in a more affordable and local way is my goal.
Thank You for choosing My Ohana, and Enjoy!!
Mahalo,
Darlynn

neighborhood_overview:
The neighborhood is located at the base of Diamond Head, near the Waikiki Aquarium, across from Kapiolani Park, on the beautiful Pacific Ocean, and within walking distance of Waikiki and its attractions. Just beyond Waikiki at the base of Diamond Head is Honolulu’s “Gold Coast.”

The Gold Coast is the last strip of buildings at the end of Kalakaua Ave. across from Kapiolani Park. Unlike the “hustle and bustle” of Waikiki, the Gold Coast is a little more quiet.Right out the front doors of these buildings offer great swimming, diving, and surfing breaks such as Tongg’s, Rice Bowls, Old Man’s, and several others. You’ve also got Kapiolani Park on the Mauka (mountain side) as I mentioned, which is a great spot for outdoor activities and the finish line for the Honolulu Marathon, the Tinman Triathlon, etc.

Also the Diamond Head Beach Hotel is less than 2 buildings away from Private Clubs such as the Elk’s Club and the Outrigger Canoe Club.

Perfect sunsets, unspoiled tropical beaches and cascading mountains surrounded by swaying palm trees are just steps from your oceanview balcony. Pono Kai offers 11 beachfront acres teeming with amenities including a long stretch of sandy beach, beautiful outdoor pool, saunas and whirlpool.

Centrally located in Kapaa on the east coast of Kauai, you’ll enjoy year round fishing charters, catamaran cruises and windsurfing. A multi-hued patchwork of scenery collides with the calming waters of the Pacific Ocean and beckons visitors to islands almost wholly volcanic in origin. Lorie

neighborhood_overview: No description
host_about:
Fall in love with the Garden Isle’s unspoiled coastline, radiant sunsets, and magical valleys during your stay at Kauai’s Poipu Shores. Our oceanfront vacation condos are the epitome of individuality, style, and comfort. 

Poipu Shores condos have a prime oceanfront location near Poipu Beach, which "Travel Channel" once named America's Best Beach. Our hotel is also within walking distance to striking Keoniloa Bay, Shipwreck, and Brennecke beaches, and a short drive to historic Koloa Town.

Our condos offer laid-back island living with stunning Pacific Ocean views, upgraded room features, and resort amenities. Our beachfront resort has two barbeque areas and a heated freshwater swimming pool that’s home to "The Hut" - an open-air lounge area where you can unwind in the year-round Poipu sun. We also provide Free Parking for guests so you explore Kauai and return with ease.

Whether you’re into relaxing beachside or venturing through Kauai’s rainforests, there’s something for everyone at Poipu Shores.

- Stay fit at nearby Poipu Athletic Club
- Tee off at at Poipu's championship golf courses
- Horseback ride along a secret beach
- Take a mountain bike excursion
- Shop Poipu’s fantastic art galleries
- Dine on fresh caught seafood
- All the Comforts of Home

Poipu Shores not only has great resort features, but each condo also comes with amenities that will make your stay feel just like home. Cook your own meals in your full-size kitchen and dine on your large private lanai/balcony while the sun sets into the deep blue Pacific. And don’t worry—every room is oceanfront! We also have Free WiFi, an in-room washer/dryer, and cable TV.

Since 1993, Castle Resorts & Hotels has specialized in innovative hotel and resort management. We manage properties throughout the Hawaiian Islands, including Kauai, Oahu, Maui, Molokai, and Hawaii Island, as well as Auckland, New Zealand. Accommodations range from full-service hotels to resort condominiums and combines value, convenience, and authentic experiences.

neighborhood_overview:
Waikiki is a beachfront neighborhood on the South Shore of Oahu.

The name Waikīkī means spouting fresh water in the Hawaiian language, for springs and streams that fed wetlands that once separated Waikīkī from the interior.

The area was a retreat for Hawaiian royalty in the 1800s who enjoyed surfing there. It is also the birthplace and playground for the famous Duke Kahanamoku, considered to be the godfather of modern surfing.

Today, Waikiki is the largest tourist resort area in the state of Hawaii.

neighborhood_overview:
Our neighborhood was established by the "Queen Liliuokalani Trust" founded in 1909 created by Hawai'i's last reigning monarch, Queen Lili'uokalani . The Queens mission for our keiki (children) to learn our Hawaiian culture through educational programs. With that said our "Kona Hale Property" is apart of the first subdivisions built here in Kona. Our Kona Hale is located on a cul-de-sac and the neighborhood is two miles above Kailua Village at an elevation of approximately 700 ft. above sea level.

Please note there are several families in our neighborhood and on occasion, during the holiday season, there is additional noise. New Years Eve and the 4th of July have legal fireworks, here in Hawai`i.

Tempting at every turn, Halii Kai at Waikoloa Resort welcomes you to discover the beauty and bliss of the Big Island’s sunny Kohala Coast within the world-famous Waikoloa Resort. You’ll love the easy lifestyle in this exclusive resort community where the best days are spent doing nothing at all.

Our beautiful coastal location between Kailua-Kona and Waimea’s upcountry puts you in the heart of Hawaii Island’s exciting recreation. Whether you’re into golf and spas or sport fishing and sailing, you’ll find your passions fulfilled.

 - Tee off on Waikoloa’s King’s and Beach courses with special guest rate
 - Catch a morning snorkeling excursion from Kawaihae Harbor
 - Explore ancient rock art in the Anaehoomalu Petroglyph Field
 - Catch monthly “Movies Under The Stars” at Queens’ MarketPlace
 - Melt into a Hawaiian lomilomi massage in an ocean side cabana
 - Horseback ride through the pastures of Kahua Ranch

Halii Kai’s spacious two, and three bedroom vacation villas and town homes are thoughtfully designed so families and friends have the perfect mix of privacy and open living spaces.

 - Privacy for parents and children 
 - Separate rooms create private space to spread out and relax.
 - Fully equipped kitchens 
 - Access to a kitchen reduces stress, saves time and cuts costs.
 - In-room washers and dryers 
 - Save time, pack less, save on baggage fees and stay fresh.
 - All the comforts of home 
 - But with daily housekeeping and amazing views.

Ridge Realty/Rentals LLC is the oldest, family owned real estate brokerage which specializes in properties at The Kapalua® Resort. For over thirty years we have maintained a solid track record, generating a customer loyalty that is second to none.  

When planning your next Maui dream vacation, do not make the mistake of staying in a hotel, most of which are small, overcrowded and overpriced. Start your vacation off right, and book your stay in one of our affordable spacious properties. All our properties come fully furnished and offer free high speed wireless internet, fully stocked kitchens, a starter supply of towels, soap/shampoo and laundry detergent, plus linens and all the other comforts of home.

Our clientele enjoy personal, around-the-clock service; staff are on-site, 24 hours a day.  Clients deserve the best and we deliver.  Allow our team to enhance your vacation with special touches; we will stock your pantry, arrange a limo service from the airport, or even create that perfect romantic atmosphere, just for your arrival – no matter the request, it is our pleasure the be there for you. We go the extra mile to ensure that your stay with Ridge Realty/Rentals is nothing short of extraordinary. Our number one priority is to accommodate you in creating a personalized, dream vacation that is as much stress free as it is memorable.

Kapalua® is fortunate to be able to claim three, world-class beaches. Kapalua Bay (rated the “number one beach in the world," by Conde Nast), Oneloa Bay and D.T. Fleming Beach are just a quick walk from all of our properties. Do not worry about parking or long drives; the best beaches in the world are just out your door!
All Kapalua® Resort activities and amenities are conveniently located within walking distance from all of our properties.  You do not feel like walking? No problem! The resort's complimentary shuttle will pick you up at your door, and then transport you to anywhere on the resort grounds.

At Ridge Realty/Rentals we feel fortunate to call Maui our home, and want nothing more than to share this beautiful paradise with you. With the warm sand between your toes, the sun upon your face and the soft trade winds at your back, you will discover an island way of living, offering the peaceful simplicity you have been searching for. We take pride in serving each and every one of our clients with the warmth of the Aloha Spirit.
 
Mahalo for your interest and we look forward to seeing you soon!

Ridge Realty/Rentals LLC is the oldest, family owned real estate brokerage which specializes in properties at The Kapalua® Resort. For over thirty years we have maintained a solid track record, generating a customer loyalty that is second to none.  

When planning your next Maui dream vacation, do not make the mistake of staying in a hotel, most of which are small, overcrowded and overpriced. Start your vacation off right, and book your stay in one of our affordable spacious properties. All our properties come fully furnished and offer free high speed wireless internet, fully stocked kitchens, a starter supply of towels, soap/shampoo and laundry detergent, plus linens and all the other comforts of home.

We go the extra mile to ensure that your stay with Ridge Realty/Rentals is nothing short of extraordinary. Our number one priority is to accommodate you in creating a personalized, dream vacation that is as much stress free as it is memorable.

Kapalua® is fortunate to be able to claim three, world-class beaches. Kapalua Bay (rated the “number one beach in the world," by Conde Nast), Oneloa Bay and D.T. At Ridge Realty/Rentals we feel fortunate to call Maui our home, and want nothing more than to share this beautiful paradise with you. With the warm sand between your toes, the sun upon your face and the soft trade winds at your back, you will discover an island way of living, offering the peaceful simplicity you have been searching for. KonaDave is a coffee farmer and world traveler!  His great, great, great uncle brought the first coffee plants to Kona in 1828, the rest is coffee history.

His daughter left dirty diapers in 24 countries before she was three. KonaDave has explored over 100 nations and states around the world. Italy is his favorite to visit.   He also runs a real estate investment company between travels.  

He loves to show people Hawaii's hidden treasures and his KonaZona Coffee Farm, Art  Gardens and Tiki Village.  Come visit him at the farm and he will let you pick all the coffee, fruit or flowers to take back to the condo.  He will share and cup of Kona Coffee or Mai Tai in his backyard Tiki Bar.  If you are lucky one of his famous parties will happen when you are in town.  They are legendary!!  The KonaZona is only 4 miles and 100 years away in historic Artist filled Holualoa town.  KonaDave  and the famous KonaZona Coffee Farm, Art Garden and Tiki Village  are easy to find on the internet. Check it out on your internet explorations of the Big Island!

host_about:
Aloha!
A little about myself; 
I moved to the Big Island in 1993 from Guam after serving a short stint in the USCG during the Golf War,  then worked as an acute care nurse at our local Hilo hospital for the last 22 years.  

Ive remained mesmerized by this island’s amazing natural beauty, diverse ecosystems, terrains, and love the laid back lifestyle it provides which easily translated into me transforming my house to one I can happily and proudly share with those seeking to explore and experience this amazing island in a relaxed home setting.  

I'm originally  from the Micronesian Island of Yap,  known for its pristine water, manta ray dives ( check out the world-famous  Yap Divers ) and  its colorful and spirited bamboo war dance performed by bare chested natives in lion clothes and grass skirts, something I grew up doing.   
I embrace  cultural diversity and truly enjoy meeting people from all walks of life and all regions in the world.  I take pride in my house and the service that I provide my guests. I value my precious 'free' time by sneaking in sporadic reading here and there  and enjoying the outdoors; camping, hiking, swimming, kayaking, paddle board, and gardening, but most of all, I love traveling and looking forward to seeing a lot more of this amazing world we live in and experience different cultures along the way.

I’m always striving for a balanced lifestyle; healthy living through heath conscious cooking utilizing locally grown, ( a lot are my own home grown) produce, keeping physically active, and inner peace and serenity.   

I look forward to meeting you and I'm excited to host another amazing adventurous soul seeking to experience the Big Island of Hawaii!  

Welcome & E Komo Mai!

Diana

neighborhood_overview:
Come visit Annie's Surf Shack located on the beautiful Kahana Bay in the Kahana Reef Condominiums. This peaceful and quaint neighborhood is located just south of Napili and only seven miles north of Lahaina. You'll find mostly privately owned accommodations with some smaller vacation complexes and no large resorts. There are plenty of shops and restaurants within walking distance, making it the perfect spot for a laid-back and local experience. If you're searching for a Zen getaway, this is the spot for you!

The condo is located near a beautiful private beach and an amazing snorkeling reef. name: May Rose Cottage
description: Open beams & split pitch roof. All stained wood.  New dwelling (built 2017); wet bar with disposal and air conditioning.
neighborhood_overview: Our dwelling is historical. It was built in 1944 by Greenwell Ranch to house their Paniolo (cowboy) workers.  The site is approx. 20,000 sf and very fertile with much rich soil (not so common in Kona).  Many guests refer to the yard as a botanical garden with many varieties of orchids and colorful vines and plants. The guest house is completely detached and a good 100 feet away.   There are privacy barriers between guest house and main house and a completely private entrance.  It is well lit with motion sensor floodlights at night.  There is also a gravel driveway through our yard right up to the  guest house if guest party is packing heavy suitcases. host_about: Aloha, I have lived on Kauai for 49 years now, owned and managed River Estate for the past 22 of them. I have gained a wealth if information here about this area and I love share it with my guests. I worked as a finish carpenter here for 20 years beginning in 1975. Then in 1995, after all the workers who came to Kauai to repair the damage from Hurricane Iniki left the island, myself and a friend put together my first website and began renting one of my long term rental homes that housed workers as a vacation home. That website was the very first vacation rental website on Kauai in 1995. And thus my vocation changed and River Estate was born...

host_about:
Aloha!  We are a Kamaʻaina family providing an unique homestay for travelers.  We have been hosting guests in our family home since 2016. We are both from the islands; I was raised on Oahu and my husband Evan grew up in Waimea. Evan works as a freelance cinematographer. We stay busy with our two children-running from soccer and baseball practice to gymnastics class. We enjoy an active lifestyle of surfing, skateboarding, hiking and exploring the outdoors. On weekends, you'll often find us at the beach. We also love traveling and are excited to show our kids the world! 

We are fortunate to live on a beautiful one acre property in Holualoa. We are surrounded by mature monkey pod and palm trees and are at the ideal elevation above Kailua Kona. The forest behind our home is so peaceful and sunsets are amazing from our property! Nature surrounds us- everyday I see a variety of colorful birds. description:
Fully furnished one bedroom condo across the street from a popular surfing beach. Take your coffee over to the beach in the morning, BBQ with a sunset view on a coconut palm lined beach in the evening! Strong and stable internet (Download 307 mbps, Upload 211mbps) to accommodate "Work From Home"!

neighborhood_overview: The condo is on Alii Drive, Kona's beach road, located midway between Kailua town and Keauhou (shopping and restaurants are just 2 1/2 miles in either direction!) host_about: My husband and I are regular travelers from our Hawaii home!  We've traveled the globe - he's a singer, and I get to come along now that our 4 kids are grown. We love being with people in their cultures, relationships, good food, adventure, new experiences.

neighborhood_overview:
Situated on Oahu's west coast, Makaha offers seclusion from the bustling city life of Honolulu, while still being within a comfortable distance for a day trip. Renowned for its beautiful beaches and incredible surf, Makaha has an inviting, laid-back atmosphere that appeals to both residents and visitors alike. Its most famous landmark, Makaha Beach Park, is a popular spot for surfing, diving, and simply enjoying the sun. Makaha's appeal lies in its relative seclusion, community feel, and access to stunning natural landscapes. From the verdant Makaha Valley to the pristine beaches, residents are never far from an outdoor adventure. Makaha offers the best of both worlds: quiet, country living, and access to major retail/shopping centers 20 minutes away!

We can usually be found in the water surfing/diving, exploring waterfalls, or in a yoga class. Aki owns a handmade sea jewelry business while Robin works full-time as a public school teacher in Waianae. Summer keeps us busy picking mangoes on our small farm, Aloha Fruits.

description:

neighborhood_overview:

host_about:
I am in the travel business leading 9 trips a year. I'm up to over 85 countries and many I have been to several times. Having traveled extensively I always look forward to coming back to my place in Maui. It's got everything I need to enjoy - the clean, warm water, sunshine, lots of choices for dining and entertainment and a big enough island to explore. 

The people who have rented my condo have all loved it. I have a guest book there that I hope you'll read and write your own blurb. I love coming back and reading how people enjoyed their stay and what made it special. 

Also, besides the turtles in the water, they are also now coming up on the beach to rest. Please stay at least 20 feet away as they are protected by Maui county and some people will get upset if they see the tourists getting too close for pictures. 

In the winter you can see lots of humpback whales. Get yourself on a whale watching tour!

name: Kona Coffee Guesthouse- Tranquility w ocean views!
description:
Get off the beaten path and stay in our tastefully decorated, ocean-view guesthouse on an organic farm in Kealakekua, South Kona. This is real paradise!
Private and clean and without any crowds, this is “Old-Hawaii” peaceful country without traffic noises and with easy access to beaches, and Kona town. You’ll love waking up to the birds and the ocean view as you sip a cup of coffee on the lanai. Enjoy a taste of Hawaii with seasonal fruit all year round and our freshly-roasted estate coffee.
neighborhood_overview:
We live in the Kona coffee belt and all of our neighbors run working coffee farms. This is a unique little pocket of "old Hawaii" acreages nestled in between newer developments, Kealakekua township and one of the largest coffee farms on the island, Greenwell Farms.

Our neighbors are all very friendly and you will find that if you come "with Aloha," then you will receive lots of Aloha in return. We are a multi-cultural family and are happy to "talk story" with you about the Hawaiian islands, culture and modern-day society that make this place special. Please be respectful of our neighbor's privacy and do not wander on to anybody else's property.
host_about:
Aloha! We met working in tourism and hospitality in Guatemala and are happy to be able to host people on our very own piece of paradise. Whether you're staying on our farm as family, a friend, a volunteer or a guest, we strive to help make your stay comfortable, relaxing, educational and fun. We look forward to being a positive part of your Hawaiian vacation!

As a multicultural and international family, we enjoy traveling and meeting people from other countries. We speak several languages (English, Spanish and Portuguese) and enjoy uncovering all the special and unique aspects of each culture.

Located on the mid-slopes of Maui’s Haleakala volcano, Makawao has one foot in its plantation past and another in its thriving arts community. This charming town was once named one of the top 25 arts destinations in the United States.
Makawao is the biggest little town in the region locally known as Upcountry Maui and is famous for its Hawaiian cowboys, or paniolo. Since the late 19th century, horseback-riding paniolo have wrangled cattle in Maui’s wide-open upland fields. The Makawao Rodeo, held yearly on the Fourth of July, is Hawaii's largest paniolo competition and has been an Upcountry tradition for more than 50 years. The weekend events include a parade and traditional rodeo competitions such as barrel racing, calf roping and bareback bronco riding, all with a few Hawaiian twists.

host_about: Born and raised in San Francisco! The youngest of 3.  I have lived in the Bay Area all of my 57 years.  Growing up in San Francisco was diverse, cultural and a plethora of things to do and explore.  Where I live now, I am surrounded by many San Franciscans who moved to the Suburbs just like me to raise their families and it's wonderful! I have been blessed to have my husband Rick whom I married in Hawaii 26 years ago and raised our 3 great kids together ages 19, & 16 year old Twins in a beautiful city called Pleasant Hill. Great community! I visited Oahu and Maui for the first time when I was 20 years old. I fell in love with Hawaii from that point on. The Aloha Spirit, Ohana, the Climate, the Smell of the flowers, the Red Earth, the beautiful Ocean, and the AMAZING SUNSETS, are 7 things I can't live without! This is where we will retire, god willing.  Traveled and visited many countries and they were all special in their own way, but my heart belongs to San Francisco and Hawaii. I love to read biographies of famous, political, noble, brilliant, entrepreneurial people who have shaped our world with their gifts, causes, belief, and determination in mankind.  I love movies that empower Women to reach their awesome potential in spite of the odds they face going through their journey.  I have been enthralled as of late with the Netflix series NARCOS!  This series covers my generation of the 70's, 80's & 90's where the empire of Narco trafficking was drastically changing our societies forever with the corruption of political and socioeconomics from the way we knew it. Growing up with my Mom and my siblings was always a pleasure to eat different foods from different cultures which gave me dinners to delight my palate and in return I raised my kids the same way.  Next to Language, Food is the best way to enter, understand and appreciate a culture!  Music to me is what describes how I am feeling and what I love. My favorite music to listen to when I drive is Hawaiian music, 2nd is Brazillian.  I love to dance to Salsa music and listen to Flamenco guitar music and of course love the Motown sound, and listen to Rap music to understand the Artist’s message it’s trying to convey to it’s generation! Hosting to me is an extension of who I am and what I stand for and that is to make an experience of traveling memorable because it shapes your perspective of people, culture, faith and wonderful differences that enriches your life forever.

This charming town was once named one of the top 25 arts destinations in the United States. Makawao is the biggest little town in the region locally known as Upcountry Maui and is famous for its Hawaiian cowboys, or paniolo. Since the late 19th century, horseback-riding paniolo have wrangled cattle in Maui’s wide-open upland fields. The Makawao Rodeo, held yearly on the Fourth of July, is Hawaii's largest paniolo competition and has been an Upcountry tradition for more than 50 years. The weekend events include a parade and traditional rodeo competitions such as barrel racing, calf roping and bareback bronco riding, all with a few Hawaiian twists. For a snack, follow the locals to get a famous cream puff from T. Komoda Store. Established in 1916 by Takezo Komoda, a Japanese plantation worker, this little store and bakery does big business. neighborhood_overview: Located on the mid-slopes of Maui’s Haleakala volcano, Makawao has one foot in its plantation past and another in its thriving arts community. This charming town was once named one of the top 25 arts destinations in the United States. Makawao is the biggest little town in the region locally known as Upcountry Maui and is famous for its Hawaiian cowboys, or paniolo. Since the late 19th century, horseback-riding paniolo have wrangled cattle in Maui’s wide-open upland fields. The Makawao Rodeo, held yearly on the Fourth of July, is Hawaii's largest paniolo competition and has been an Upcountry tradition for more than 50 years. The weekend events include a parade and traditional rodeo competitions such as barrel racing, calf roping and bareback bronco riding, all with a few Hawaiian twists. For a snack, follow the locals to get a famous cream puff from T. Komoda Store. Established in 1916 by Takezo Komoda, a Japanese plantation worker, this little store and bakery does big business. host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

neighborhood_overview:
Our neighborhood was made famous during the 2018 eruption of the Kilauea volcano. Please be respectful of the lava - it is beautiful to look at, but do not touch it or walk on it. Lava covered private properties and homes in the neighborhood, and it is illegal to walk on the lava in the neighborhood. Also, it is unsafe to walk on the lava. name: Living On Aloha! In Oceanview, Hawaii
description: Come one, come all to the Big Island. You are welcome here to rest and relax in this private suite attached to my dream house. Located on the slopes of Mauna Loa; halfway between Kona and Volcano National Park, Aloha House is the perfect retreat from the hustle and bustle of your life, located at the 80 mile marker. A great place to land while exploring the real natural beauty of the Big Island.
neighborhood_overview: Oceanview is the largest subdivision in the United States. The roads are private and sometimes they refer to the upper regions as "The wild west!" it is a unique, raw and beautiful place to drive around but I don't recommend visiting the neighbors without an invitation. The Oceanview market is located around the corner and 2 miles down hill on Lehua St. There are coffee and pizza shops, grocery store and gas. Saturday mornings there is a large swap meet across the highway next to Malama Market, our other grocery store. L&L grill serves local favorites at a reasonable price. There are also a few restaurants around. Thai and Family dining.
host_about:
E Komi mai! Welcome, I am a woman raising a wonderful teenager who was lucky enough to find her dream home in Hawaii where I have lived for 40 years. I am a teacher and used to be an active member of our local community theater in Kona and Hilo. I have lived in Oceanview for just over five years and love it. I never want to live without coffee, chocolate or macnuts and Kau has it all, as well as some exquisite scenery and wonderful people. 
I have traveled all over the world and done some Airbnb in California and Oregon. I love to meet new people, learn about their dreams and travel experiences. I’m always open to hearing about your tips and any hidden Jems  you find here on the Big Island. 
Aloha 
Catherine

One concept i live by is "Life is for the living"  I enjoy sharing these good times with other adventurous people. 

I work 9-6pm weekdays and other time am out surfing, kiting, adventuring etc. Im very tolerant  and respectful and because the house is still under repair everything is pretty easy going and relaxed.

Not a party house, but small gatherings are welcomed.

name: Walk 5 min. to see dolphins in Kealakekua Bay
description: The Ohana (rental unit) is the entire ground floor. Walk down the street to enter Kealakekua Bay (aka Dolphin Bay) to see humpbacks, and swim with dolphins in the crystalline blue water. Or walk 5 minutes other direction to Manini beach park. Sleep to the lullaby of ocean waves. Watch the sunset from the hammock on the deck or lanai. Two other beloved swim spots: Honaunau National Park & Ho'okena are 10 to 20 minutes drive.
neighborhood_overview: Kealakekua Bay is the "cream de la cream" of ocean spot for swim, snorkel, dive or lay back and watch dolphins. Watch them jump and spin while you are in the water is the greatest treat I can think of.  If you relax and swim slowly, they might even swim around you.  "Ke ala" means the path.  "Ke kua" roughly translates to the Gods or the heavens. Hawaiian people consider this a very sacred place! Water is usually clear (you can see the sandy bottom where its over 30 feet deep, calm and full of tropical fishes. You might swim next to a Manta Ray or turtle any day, a feast for the eyes and senses. Note all of the mentioned marine life are daily encounter in any of the bays I mentioned. The house is in a neighborhood known as Napo'opo'l village or Manini village.  Very laid back and secluded. I got the feel of a real Hawaii when I first stayed here.  It is beyond a dream come true to call this my home since October 2017. Come join me:)
host_about: I love swimming with dolphins. The crystalline blue water is  made more magical when the Spinner dolphins come in to the bays. I have been to 20+ countries and the money I get from renting part of my home funds more travel.  I am a foodie, gourmet cook, and holistic medicine practitioner. I left Hong Kong, my birth place when I was eighteen.  Lived on the East coast USA for 43 years. I left Hilton Head in 2017. Now I live on this paradise call the Big Island.  It is beyond any dream come true!  I live a quiet peaceful life with my boy-cat, Om. I like meeting people (no strangers in my world). I enjoy music, books, movies and learning spirituality. I have a private practice of Energy Medicine and Sound Healing, and work +/-10 hours a week,  . I am joyful, loving, fun, neat, clean, kind and considerate.  NON-smoker. My joy comes from helping people and making others happy. When I pick a travel destination, the quality of food is a big part of the decision.

Beautiful & Spacious, walking distance to town. Laminate wood flooring, white shaker kitchen cabinets-quartz counter tops, two bathrooms- wonderful large shower, second with tub. Stainless steel appliances. King size bed, sleeper sofa in living room. Washer/dryer in unit, assigned parking. Beautiful swimming pool area with barbecues and a small ocean view. 3rd floor unit with easy stairwell access or you can take the elevator. You will hear garage door open and close.
2 NIGHT MIN. STAY.
neighborhood_overview: ~Near the heart of town, easy access to restaurants, public transportation, village, near beaches in town, amenities.  Condos and homes in the area.
host_about:
Aloha and thank you for reviewing our listings. We offer vacation as well as long term units.  All are located on The Big Island, HI.  This has been our home for many years, and we never tire of the beautiful ocean, skies, mountains, and waterfalls.    It is peaceful and yet full of adventure.  For the first time visitor, you will find many different climatic zones- lush green foliage, lava, volcanos, beaches, fabulous tropical fragrances and fruits.  These are just some of the things that keep us here on the big island.  We also enjoy the "small"town like feeling and "Aloha" which separates us from the main tourist islands.

Our units are owner/operated.  Whether on vacaation, business, or long term, we hope that your visit to our lovely island will be most enjoyable, refreshing, and memorable.   It would be our pleasure to help you achieve this.

description: Newly renovated, modern, ground floor unit fit for Maui style and ease. Tropical murals and local paintings throughout this lovely condo, done by the graphic artist owner and his wife to give you the true Hawaiian feel!
neighborhood_overview: No description
host_about:
The complex is located directly across from Kamaole III State Beach Park, which is known as one of the most beautiful and safest beaches in the Islands.  It is perfect for swimming, snorkeling, sunning, jogging, picnicking, kite flying, and especially enjoying amazing sunsets and whale watching.

Each unit has a private lanai that faces the interior of the complex, offering views of the expansive lawns, pools, and lush tropical landscape of palm trees, hibiscus, birds of paradise and plumeria trees.  Most lanais also offer views of the beautiful Pacific Ocean and spectacular sunsets.

You will find world class golf courses, fantastic snorkeling and diving, many Maui activities, abundant shopping and delicious fine and family dining all within minutes of Hale Kamaole.

Part of the famed Kohala Coast and near the Hapuna Prince, Mauna Kea and Mauna Lani resorts the area basks in three hundred plus days of sunshine and an average of nine inches of rain per year.

In the 1800’s this area was the thriving center of Kamehameha I’s kingdom and contains many archeological cultural remnants as well as the National Historical Site, Pu’u Kohola Heiau (Hawaiian temple).

Situated in a private residence in the Kohala Estates subdivision three miles north of the town of Kawaihae. At 500 feet above sea level, this location offers panoramic views of the coastline and year round sunsets.

During the winter months the warm waters offer sanctuary to nursing humpback whales. You can see the spouts and breaches and hear the echo of their fins slapping the ocean surface and their songs at night.

After retiring a few years ago, we have been traveling to places like Africa, New Zealand, Belize, Guatemala, and Peru. After having been exposed to so much in our travels with the various types of lodging and experiencies, we realized (once again) that we really do live in paradise. Doug and Donna King

name: Beachside  private studio  Steps to surf and sand
description: Welcome Travelers! Escape the hustle & bustle, & make this eclectic STUDIO with 1 QUEEN sized bed  your cozy home base to explore Hawaii’s iconic North Shore! Feel secure in your own separate space. This STUDIO is in a coastal family neighborhood of the historic plantation town of Waialua. Just a hop & a skip down to the beach access wth a white sand neighborhood beach, that's not only swimmable year-round, but also boasts honu (Hawaiian sea turtles), snorkeling, surf and Stand Up Paddle spots.
neighborhood_overview:
The immediate area is a mixed density, family, active, seaside neighborhood. You will see many residents biking, jogging, fishing, enjoying Aweoweo Beach Park with their families, and carrying surfboards of all sizes.
There is a collection of unique shops in the converted Waialua Sugar Mill, which is a great place to pick up souveniers and gifts.
Located a few minutes north east is the bustling town of Haleiwa where one can find eateries of all kinds. Grab a shave ice, some locally roasted coffee, or a snack, and cruise all the unique shops. Or, if it is adventure you are craving -there are numerous places to rent boards, or kayaks, get some surfing lessons, or go on a Shark Boat. Or, a short drive further west will bring you skydiving and horseback riding.
And most of all, please find the time to explore all the beauty that the Seven Mile Miracle has to offer. From sun bathing to surf contests, hikes to gorgeous sunsets, we are sure you will make beautiful memories h
host_about: We traveled quite a bit, domestically, as a child, from Hawaii, to the mountains of Colorado, the Everglades of Florida, to sailing the Bahamas in a catamaran my family built. I have continued this love of new places as an adult as an avid "road tripper", and cherish the experiences one can have with the locals in each new place. Which is why we love to share our love of Hawaii with travelers. :)

description: Entire second floor of home with wrap around lanai. Comfortable Island Style decor with skylights. Located next to Waipio Lookout rich in Hawaiian history. Ten minute drive to Historical Honoka'a Town with restaurants, movie theatre, grocery stores, shopping, art galleries, post office and hospital. neighborhood_overview: I live in a very quaint neighborhood with a country feel. There is a nice park 10 minutes away along with gallery and restaurants and a great fruit stand that serves fresh coconut water out of the coconut itself!. the town of Honokaa is a 10 minute drive with grocery stores , cafes, restaurants, cute shops, post office, grocery store, more galleries, ice cream and  homemade fudge shops! It has medical facilities, ER, fire and police station and to balance that out a 100% solar powered Movie theater with top notch live music, Really famous musicians play there! amazing to me to see Judy Collins, David Crosby(RIP)and so many~ecstatic Dance~etc.~ there is a sweet local park with a baseball field and park benches and tables a short walk from home! Not much traffic~the Waipio Valley shuttle is close by in front of Waipio Art Gallery. there are some lovely places to hike 10-20 miles away. Kalopa state park and then near Waimea town. Farmers markets in Honokaa and Waimea are lovely. Great caf
host_about: I sailed to Hawaii in 1985, after being lost at sea in a storm. The dolphins escorted me to refuge in Kealakekua Bay on the Big island. A feeling of gratitude is overwhelming. Finding a place of serenity while living a simple life is a gift. I feel a deep connection to this special Island rich in history and spiritual "Mana." I am a licensed massage therapist . I have been passionate about aromatherapy since 1980 and created a spa line called Hananaia-meaning "to have great love for the Hawaiian Spinner Dolphin." The feeling of Waipio is magical. I love meeting people and welcoming them with the Aloha spirit. These days many people need to feel a deeper connection to self , spirit and purpose. Waipio Hale Pinao (Home of the Dragonfly) offers a safe and sacred space for this journey. It also enhances creativity for artists, writers, musicians, and dreamers of all types. It has a heartfelt felling of joy that has a healing affect on one's spirit. It also satisfies the adventurer while nurturing the creative energies!

Kauai’s north shore is also where you’ll find some of the most spectacular scenery in Hawaii. There are three main beaches in Princeville, which are Kenomene Beach, Kaweonui Beach and Puu Poa Beach. A wide reef along these beaches creates warm pockets for swimming and snorkeling in calm weather. Other area activities  include tennis, golf, windsurfing, kayaking, fishing, sailing, helicopter tours and shopping. You can arrange for a private guided jungle hike, waterfall excursion or kayaking adventure.

host_about:
I love to travel. I found airbnb while traveling through Asia and loved it. If it's not adventurous it's probably not worth doing. I grew up in warmer climate and love to surf, however the snow has provided me a chance to snowboard. I've lived and worked in Manhattan for over 13 years, so I can give you plenty of recommendations on where to eat and what to visit.

I've made life lasting friendships and have even traveled out of country to attend my new friends weddings. I've traveled all over Europe, Africa, Asia, South America and Central America, usually by camping or staying in local villages. Some highlights have been scaling a glacier in Iceland just after a volcanic eruption, coming face to face with a wild female lion in Zambia, speeding through limestone cliffs under the stars on a long-tail in Thailand, scuba diving off the coast of Nusa Lembongan, and surfing 8 foot rock slab breaks in Nicaragua. Staying in another's home is the best way to really experience a new city, you feel like a local. I'm grateful for the hospitality that was provided to me and I'm hosting now to return the favor. Hope you enjoy the greatest island in the world.

host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

We are literally around the corner from some of the most celebrated restaurants and cafes on the Big Island. Merriman's Restaurant, Red Water Cafe, Hawaiian Style cafe, Waimea Coffee Company and Pau Restaurant are all just a few minutes walk away.

This will be a wonderful experience for me getting to meet really nice and interesting people from all over the world to share this beautiful island.

host_about:
Hi, we are an international couple, we're well traveled with us both living internationally for many years. We now live and enjoy a small corner of heaven know as the North Shore of Oahu, the birth place of surfing, yet still wild and full of beautiful beaches.    We're Honest, clean, tidy out going people and have an active,  fun lifestyle enjoying the amazing water sports here. I am renting out the spare studio attached to my house, to hopefully meet interesting people, share a bit of the "HI" life/aloha spirit and help pay the bills. 

We moved to Hawaii 7 years ago, thinking it would be a nice place to live for a couple of years, make some money and then get back to travelling. I under estimated how nice and how much fun it is to live here, and now I have a house here and no desire to leave. The laid back country atmosphere we have here on the North Shore is alluring- so much nicer than the crazy Waikiki tourist sausage machine.

I'm active and try to complete the whole range of sports possible here on the north shore. In fact my favorite days are when you get a "trifecta" - any three of the surfing, kiting, free diving SUPPing, mountain biking, motocross, beaching, hiking etc actives possible here.

One concept i live by is "Life is for the living"  I enjoy sharing these good times with other adventurous people. 

I work 9-6pm weekdays and other time am out surfing, kiting, adventuring etc. Im very tolerant  and respectful and because the house is still under repair everything is pretty easy going and relaxed.

Not a party house, but small gatherings are welcomed.

Shores of Maui is a fabulous place for all types of travelers. Unbelievable ocean view, centrally located and easy on the budget. 

Maui Kamaole is an upscale, resort style vacation with the luxury of beautiful furnishings, landscaping and all the amenities you would expect of Wailea living at Kihei prices.

Give us a good (or any) reason to travel and we'll hit the road. Ocean, historic sites, cruising or road trips...but, we also love our Maui and San Diego homes. In San Diego, we live in a 1921 historic apartment house set on the slope of an urban canyon. It truly is urban living with a country feel.

We've rented our Maui home at Shores of Maui to vacationers for the past 21 years. We open our Maui Kamaole home for guests wanting a longer stay of 7 days or longer. 

Our philosophy is providing a "home away from home" for travelers who appreciate staying in a place that is well cared for. We treat the condos we rent as we would our own home. We hope our renters feel the same way.

description: Welcome to Reina's Hideaway, our little slice of paradise!  This cool, one bedroom condo has everything you need to make yourself at home.  Our goal is to make sure you enjoy your stay!
neighborhood_overview: The Sandpiper is centrally located in Princeville. The Makai Golf Course across the street has a great jogging/walking path, and it's a 15 minute walk to the Princeville Center for shopping and dining.
host_about: Hello, I'm Claudia, I'm happy to share my home, aka  "Reina's Hideaway" with you! Reina is the nickname my sister jokingly gave to my mother years ago, and it stuck.   Reina loved Hawaii. She loved the sunsets, the Mai Tai's, the sand between her toes. My mom and I shared the love of travel. We came to Hawaii more times than I can count, and also  traveled to Mexico, England, France, and Scotland, to name a few destinations. Her verve for life is an inspiration for me. "Have Pillow, Will Travel!" became her motto, and I'm stealing it! I prefer to stay where I can meet and interact with the locals, and that doesn't happen in a Hilton.  I like to try local cuisine and have eaten some unusual, if not questionable foods. I love seeking out  live music, and could sit all night if the sound is right. host_about:
Hi, we are an international couple, we're well traveled with us both living internationally for many years. We now live and enjoy a small corner of heaven know as the North Shore of Oahu, the birth place of surfing, yet still wild and full of beautiful beaches.    We're Honest, clean, tidy out going people and have an active,  fun lifestyle enjoying the amazing water sports here. I am renting out the spare studio attached to my house, to hopefully meet interesting people, share a bit of the "HI" life/aloha spirit and help pay the bills. 

We moved to Hawaii 7 years ago, thinking it would be a nice place to live for a couple of years, make some money and then get back to travelling. I under estimated how nice and how much fun it is to live here, and now I have a house here and no desire to leave. The laid back country atmosphere we have here on the North Shore is alluring- so much nicer than the crazy Waikiki tourist sausage machine.

I'm active and try to complete the whole range of sports possible here on the north shore. In fact my favorite days are when you get a "trifecta" - any three of the surfing, kiting, free diving SUPPing, mountain biking, motocross, beaching, hiking etc actives possible here.

One concept i live by is "Life is for the living"  I enjoy sharing these good times with other adventurous people. 

I work 9-6pm weekdays and other time am out surfing, kiting, adventuring etc. Im very tolerant  and respectful and because the house is still under repair everything is pretty easy going and relaxed.

Not a party house, but small gatherings are welcomed.

description:

BBQ's are located in the cabana at the pool area. The cabana also has a large library of books and beautiful reading area overlooking the ocean with views of Maui to the east and Lanai to the south. It also has tennis courts and a lawn shuffle board.
The grounds are meticulously maintained by on-site employees.

host_about:
They say, “when you do what you love, you never work a day in your life.” Managing property and traveling through America’s coastal region has armed me with the experience necessary to provide you with a quality place to stay in some of the country’s most stunning locations. 

I have been a property manager and owner for 19 years. 30 years ago, I made Lantana my home, and I am proud to say it is still the great coastal town that I grew up loving. Whether you enjoy going to the beach, boating, shopping, or sampling the local fare, Lantana is the place to go - and stay a little while. 

I have also spent a lot of time on the Big Island of Hawaii, and like most, remain fascinated by all that it has to offer.  This was why I took on the adventure of converting shipping containers into off-grid vacation bungalows on the lava fields of Kalapana. It was an adventure I will never forget. These lush interiors are situated directly on the lava field and under a night sky lit by thousands of twinkling stars.  With the ocean as your view and Kilauea volcano in your backyard, it is truly a once in a lifetime experience you won’t soon forget. 

A hui hou,
Ron
Living a Joyful & Blessed Life

host_about:
Waimanalo Beach Cottages  looking for beach goers and people who love the out doors and the appreciation for chilling. We are not a hotel. 

We offer 9 Cottages Perfect for large groups Minimum stay 7 nights.

Book all 9 cottages or just one cottage. 

Historical Waimanalo Beach Cottages is a beautiful country getaway. Steps from beautiful Waimanalo Beach where you see the incredible sunrise. 

We are in the in the tropics where you will find occasional ants, geckos and the salt air does create rust so quickly it is hard to keep up. There are also three cats and birds who reside on property. If you aren’t a fan of any of the above pease look elsewhere.

Our business is a Hawaii State Licensed vacation rental. We offer nine 
cottages that comfortably accommodate up to 24 guests. We have full-size kitchens that include the comforts of home with your family and friends. Our local grocery stores are nearby making your stay relaxed and affordable.

Our journey began over 60 years when Andrea Peters, mother, and grandmother purchased Waimanalo Beach Cottages, formerly known as Waimanalo Motel by a family who managed the Waimanalo sugar mill. At this time many military personals would vacation at the cottages with friends and relatives.

Once purchased, Waimanalo Beach Cottages were occupied by residents for long-term rentals. Within the last 15 years, Waimanalo Beach Cottages has transformed from residential rentals to vacation rentals, allowing our many visitors to enjoy our part of history and experience old Hawaii at its best.

So what makes us different?
Our family-run business has grown significantly over the years, but our commitment to giving you an extensive range of quality cottages at a good value hasn’t changed.

Our customer service with aloha brings our clients back time and time again, and for the holidays with large groups and events booked each year. I have to say “we must be getting something right”. 

Waimanalo Beach Cottages offers you Aloha. Each cottage in has been personally inspected and approved by our owners before your check-in. From breath-taking ocean views and landscapes, we offer something for everyone. Enjoy your Stay! We are in the tropics and you will find little critters especially if you leave food out.

name: English Cottage in Hawaii
description: Aloha and welcome to our cozy,  rustic, little English Cottage in Hawaii! A charming remodeled classic Kona Coffee Shack. Nestled on a quiet and private acre. Walking distance from the historic village of Holualoa . With art galleries, yoga and massage studio, post office and a local store. Just 10 minutes drive from Kona town and a beach. neighborhood_overview:
This property is 5 minutes walk from the quaint artist village of Holualoa. The cafe serves the best organic Kona coffee. The Holuakoa Gardens is a wonderful, farm to table restaurant in a lovely outdoor setting.
You will enjoy strolling the different art galleries and shops and if your stay happens to be on the first Friday of the month, don’t miss Holualoa’s First Friday event when the village comes alive with food booths and music from 5 to 8pm. The drive to Kona town is about 15 minutes. The Airport is a 20 minute drive away. The closet beach is Magic Sands, about 10 minutes away.
host_about:
I am originally from England and have lived on the Big Island for 20 years. I have 3 grown up children, a stepson, a lovely husband, 2 dogs and 2 cats. I love the beautiful nature and ocean of Hawaii. I swim in the ocean  several times a week. I love traveling all over the globe but happy to call Hawaii and my humble coffee shack home.
I enjoy meeting new friends and appreciate clear communication, cleanliness and positive energy.
