host_about:
Robert or "Tag" as is known to friends has been working in hospitality marketing for 3 decades. 

For my 6th birthday I got a Hawaiian shirt and a trip over my hometown in a little single engine airplane. That's when I got bitten by the travel bug. Since then I've had the incredible honor of representing The Leading Hotels of the World, Ltd. and several of their iconic, independent properties. I have also worked with Mandarin, Fairmont, Intercontinental as well as some exceptional cruise lines and major travel destinations. It is a thrill to connect passionate travelers with authentic experiences that celebrate a "sense of place." This is a term I learned from the very best hoteliers in the world, each of whom has successfully delivered his or her own expression of what this means. To share that feeling with people who delight in authentic experiences that embrace the land, history and local culture is nothing short of magic. 

There is no property I have ever seen that celebrates a sense of place better than Kapehu Falls. This grand estate still recalls its time as a sugar cane plantation. Part of the old Sugar Cane Road is still evident and the purplish-silver cane flowers still grow wild in the brush by the pasture. The barn and main house are exquisite modern adaptations of a plantation manager's homestead – complete with high ceilings and ornate flourishes from a by-gone era. Over 15 acres is a mature, replanted forest, surrounded by winding streams, waterfalls and natural formations that honor all that came before us. It is a luxurious preserve that shares its story with all who care to listen and experience this magical enclave.

Former Kapehu owner and operational genius, Marcy, is a new friend, advisor and a new customer. For Marcy and all the passionate travelers who deeply appreciate the spirit, history and natural beauty of the destinations they visit, my team and I are committed to making your stay special. I've earned dozens of awards from the hospitality experts at HSMAI, but no award or accolade means as much to me as your experience at Kapehu Falls.

name: Sunny and Soothing Oceanfront Vistas
description: Completely remodeled sophisticated oceanfront 1 bedroom, 1 bath condo, with fabulous views from the fourth floor is located in the sunny and vibrant beach town of Kihei. Beach chairs, umbrellas, boogie boards, floating noodles, luxury beach towels and a cooler are all provided to enjoy your day at the beach! Upon your return a fully outfitted condo awaits. Whether you dine out (there are great restaurants nearby) or stay in, you will enjoy your new home away from home in Maui.
neighborhood_overview: The Kihei community enjoys several beautiful beaches, most all with nearby convenient public parking.  In Maui all beaches must be accessible to the public allowing both visitors and residents the opportunity to fully enjoy the variety and beauty of the local beaches.  Together with neighboring Wailea the area enjoys numerous shops, restaurants and “happy hour” opportunities.  Kauhale Makai complex is a short distance from many grocery stores, including a Safeway, Times and Foodland, convenient for visitors who did not have the opportunity to stop in to Costco or Target by the airport prior to their arrival at the complex to check-in.
host_about: Traveling on company business trips five days a week for eighteen years has taught us what is important to guests. This inspired us to create the ideal environment and provide the right amenities for the perfect stay.  Happiness can be about the journey that produces it and we found it on Maui, the “ valley island”.  After visiting Maui for many years on vacation for a break from business travel, we moved here permanently a few years ago. We chose Kihei, a relaxed ocean front surfing community that thrives with the aloha spirit! We welcome you into our Ohana.

• This tiny section of the Kohala Coast has the best weather on the islands: with less than 10 inches of rain annually, the winds and water are often calm in the morning, giving way to onshore breezes in the evening as the cool descends from Mauna Kea and Kohala Mountain. Temperatures commonly top out at 83ºF (28ºC) from September-May, and 86ºF (30ºC) June-August.

host_about: Hello, I'm Claudia, I'm happy to share my home, aka  "Reina's Hideaway" with you! Reina is the nickname my sister jokingly gave to my mother years ago, and it stuck.   Reina loved Hawaii. The ocean is always fun to watch and is particularly beautiful at the end of Beach Road to the south of Paradise Road about a mile from the house.

If you're interested in experiencing pristine Hawaii this is a great place to do it. My place offers the convenience of being only 10 minutes from the convenience store in Orchidland, 15 minutes from Keaau, with a grocery store and a bunch of other restaurants and shops, 25 minutes from Hilo and the airport, but also out in the country with the ocean waves audible from your room and very few neighbors. description: Looking forward to meeting you and sharing this sacred land with you! This property has been enjoyed for over 30 years in the community! Kahuna's would pray here daily. neighborhood_overview: There are local art and music events happening throughout the week.  Ecstatic dances on Thurs, Friday and Sundays in the area. Kehena Beach, Shipman's Beach, and a few local secret spots are still open to visit for a swim or snorkel. This is authentic Hawaii, an area where time can stand still. host_about: Gray and I are so grateful to be stewards of this magical land! We love to do our best to create a wonderful experience for our guests. We love to start our day with a quiet walk in the jungle and our way back gather produce from our neighborhood fruit stands.  We enjoy the quiet laid back vibe we have on this side of the island and one of the cleanest airs on the planet!   Our favorite part of this property is all the fruit trees and the plush landscape !

Please don't let this take away from the awesome neighbors. This home offers basic accommodations it is not a luxury rental.

description: Maui Vista  is a beautiful Kihei Resort only steps away from the sand and surf of Kam. 1 and Charlie Young Beach. host_about:
My wife Carol and I have been traveling to Maui since 2002.  We had always wanted to go to Hawaii.  No one was traveling at that time (6 months after 9/11) and air fares were very reasonable.  We went to Oahu, Kauai, the Big Island and Maui.  We found something special on Maui and returned almost every year since.  We purchased our condo at Maui Vista Resort January of 2015.  Each of us are retired and enjoy working around our house here in South East Michigan.  Summers are nice here but the winters can get difficult.  The older we get the more we find that the warm weather on Maui is where we should be.  The discussion of moving to Maui has come up, but family will keep us here.  We would like to spend more time at our Maui home, and do plan that in the future.  We currently like to go to Maui for about three weeks in the early spring and three weeks in the fall.  
We took over responsibility of managing our property last August and have found the experience to be great.  Helping our guests  navigate around Maui, understanding what they might find interesting and exciting has been so much fun.  We want our guests to enjoy their stay as much as we do each and every time we go.  Someone once told me that after you go somewhere on vacation, the second time is never as nice or as much fun.  We have found that each time we go to Maui, the experience is better than the time before.

neighborhood_overview:
Gorgeous and quiet area of the island with many beautiful homes. This is a residential neighborhood on the ocean cliffs. There IS NOT beach access in the neighborhood but the cliffs are beautiful, with long walks possible along the cliffs that ring the entire bay. You can access the cliffs at the bottom of Paradise Road a mile from my house, at the end of Beach Road in the same area, or at Makuu Pt at the bottom of Makuu Road two miles away.

There are some deep tide pools you can swim in near Maku'u Point. Whales pass by during winter. The ocean is always fun to watch and is particularly beautiful at the end of Beach Road to the south of Paradise Road about a mile from the house.

If you're interested in experiencing pristine Hawaii this is a great place to do it. My place offers the convenience of being only 10 minutes from the convenience store in Orchidland, 15 minutes from Keaau, with a grocery store and a bunch of other restaurants and shops, 25 minutes fro

neighborhood_overview:
Volcano Village is a quaint, quiet community in the highland rainforest next to Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park, on the Big Island. This unique arts & science community has a distinct Old Hawai'i atmosphere with a "village center" consisting of a post office, two gas stations, two ‘mom-and-pop’ grocery stores and a variety of good restaurants.

Volcano Village is located at the 4000 ft. elevation, so don't expect to see sandy beaches and coconut trees! This majestic area is a World Heritage Site and a designated International Biosphere Reserve. It features incredible bio-diversity including a tropical upland rainforest filled with lush foliage and wild ginger, orchids, Hapu'u ferns and Ohia trees with bright red Lehua blossoms.

Right next door to the north, you'll enjoy local tavern called Dina's Sandwitch for casual dining with a full bar. Of course, by car there are abundance options from casual dining in South Kihei to fine dining in Wailea and Mama's Fish House in Paia. You can drive to Safeway, Foodland, Costco, Target, Walmart and local shops. For your shopping needs, you will find everything from souvenir T-shirts to expensive high-end Louis Vuitton handbags to Rolex watches at the Shop in Wailea.

Your condo location is pretty much centrally located on the island roughly 15 minutes from the airport and all major stores. It is great for those who wish to see other parts of Maui and then return home to their condo for a relaxing evening watching the colorful sunset. There is nothing like relaxing in front of a beautiful skyline, the perfect end to any day.
host_about:
I have had the privilege of traveling all over Europe, Asia, Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean Islands and across the US for both business and personal trips. Of all the places that I have been, Maui is the only place that I feel right at home. Fell in love with Maui since my first visit in the early part of 1990s. Since then, I have returned for a vacation getaway every year and in 2020 moved to Maui permanently! The island is breathtaking, the beaches are spectacular and the people are welcoming.

I came across Kihei Sands Beachfront Condominiums walking along Sugar Beach on one rainy night in December not too long ago. When I stepped onto this property, I instantly felt safe and relaxed. It was serene and calm.  I saw a sky luminous with infinite number of stars, felt the warm rain on my skin, heard the ocean waves crashing against the shore and observed the guests socializing as they were having fun by the BBQs. When some of the guests saw me sitting on the lounge chair, they came over and offered to share their dinner with me. I was taken back by their kindness and the atmosphere of Kihei Sands. I knew right then that I had to be an owner here. 

I finally bought unit A5, a 1 Bedroom/1 Bath Condo in January of 2017. 

A5 has many repeat guests. I love sharing the Spirit of Aloha with others. My goal is to provide you a Great VACATION Experience with MEMORIES that will last a LIFETIME. Kihei Sands is truly a HIDDEN GEM.

description: No Cleaning Fees! Escape to the enchanting Kikala Waterfall Lodge, nestled on the pristine Hamakua coastline just minutes from Hilo. neighborhood_overview:
Our neighborhood is nestled in a picturesque, pastoral area along the stunning Hamakua Coast, just north of Hilo, at an ideal elevation of 1,600 feet. The climate here is perfection—balmy, pleasant days and refreshingly cool nights, where you’ll feel comfortable in shorts and a T-shirt, with no need for air conditioning.

Though we’re only a 12-minute drive from the vibrant energy of downtown Hilo, our location feels like a secluded mountain retreat. Surrounded by waterfalls, swimming holes, and a breathtaking nature preserve, it’s a true escape into Hawaii’s natural beauty.
host_about:

Somehow as adults we just forget. My boys are also lucky to have the most amazing mom in the world, my wife Michelle who will go to the ends of the earth for them.

Most days I can be found tending to our lush tropical farm overlooking Hilo Bay where we take care of a herd of dairy cows and dairy goats and chickens and turkeys. I love the tropics and love to travel to far away places like Southeast Asia, the islands, Thailand, well, any place tropical. 

I aspire to be open minded and I like to hang out with others that share that aspiration. As a host, I'd like to get to know my guests and do my best to be a good host that will make their stay better and more fun. I am always curious to meet world travelers from other countries.

name: Tropical Tree House and Studio Canopy near Pahoa
description: Welcome to the Tropical Tree Homestead! Together but separate, we offer two adjacent handcrafted dwellings with an interconnecting yard. The Homestead is one mile to Kehena beach, six miles to the new Po'hoiki black sand beach, the new lava flows, and many tide pools along the red road. Perfect for two groups or large families. Laze about in the hammock. Lot's of love has gone into the custom wood, stone and landscape work. Unique and unconventional in every way. You'll love the Homestead!
neighborhood_overview: Located in Puna the house is nestled into the jungle of east Hawaii and is a ten minute walk to the black sand beach of Kehena, where there may be dolphins to play with, as well as seasonal whale watching. A short drive will land you at Unlce Roberts Kava bar, where you will often find the Uncles playing old Hawaiian country songs on Wednesday night. Also, at Uncle Roberts is the Saturday morning farmers market. Kalani Honua resort is located right next door, where you can find Sunday morning dance, wonderful dining options, workshops of all kinds and a store. Drive down the red road and you will come across tide pools and naturally heated warm ponds, both are great for swimming and healing. And don't forget to check out Poohiki, our local surf spot. Historical Pahoa town is just fifteen minutes away.
host_about:
Aloha, I made a lifestyle decision to move to Hawaii in 2005. I fell in love with the Big Island for the first time in 97. Since then I've explored homesteading and a closer connection to our land. I have been building and creating. Now I am ready to share the house with travelers who visit this magical place. I am into a peaceful sustainable existence, that gives rest to a fast moving civilization. Sometimes it is enough to just look at the stars, and here you can see them well, or just return to the original TV, a nice relaxing fire. And I love to cook on the flames, so simple, so good. Sharing food is my favorite form of communion. I love slow cooking, whether it be smoking or stew making. Slower and longer is just better if you ask me. 

I am a builder, and as a builder the most gratifying thing is to see people enjoying the manifestations that have been created. Sometimes the focus of what it means to construct something for the utilitarian purpose gets lost in the process. But, the magic is always underlying everything, so many times pure serendipity is right there, reminding us. The intention is everything and construed in all the stones carried, wood carved, land sculpted and much, much else. When the energy is pure, then it is easily conveyed or felt. This land is unfolding as the volcano has taught us. All who become part of this history will see how powerful is the asking. My experience here is that there is an instant reflection in the asking. Have fun and come and see...After all this is some of the newest land on this planet.

name: Private Bungalow (Hula Hale)
description: Tucked along the Kohala coast lies the beautifully secluded Starseed Ranch, only one mile from the breathtaking Pololū Valley. Surrounded by powerful ocean, lush jungle, fertile agriculture, and rushing streams, it’s the perfect place to reconnect with the land and center yourself in nature while enjoying modern comforts. Our 26-acre estate and organic farm is completely off-grid, run by hydroelectric and solar systems. We have several lodging options available, please see our other listings.
neighborhood_overview: We are in North Kohala, near historic Hawi and Kapa'au towns. This is a remote and culturally rich area with much to explore. Just a few minutes from the ranch, at the ‘end of the road’, lies the entrance to Pololu Valley. This spot is known as one of the most beautiful on Hawai’i Island. Visitors can hike down to the black sand beach and catch a glimpse into the first of seven valleys that make up the Hamakua and Kohala coastline. A breathtaking adventure not to be missed! Other nearby attractions include ocean beaches, snorkeling, hiking, eco-tour adventures, shopping, galleries, restaurants, farmers market, historical sites.
host_about:
We have been blessed to call North Kohala, Hawai'i home for over a decade. This is where we raise our family and run our farm and nonprofit, HIP Agriculture. As educators, we work with island youth around issues of food sovereignty, farmer training, and building resiliency. At Starseed Ranch under HIP ag,  we host farm field trips for local school groups and farmer training workshops.

Starseed Ranch has a vibrant history of sustainability and community, and we are honored to serve as stewards. This land has always held a special place in our hearts as we were married here in 2011, and have returned many times over the years to spend time with the previous owners, Jyoti and Andre. We have been hosting overnight lodging and special events since 2019,  and are excited to welcome more people to this beautiful and sacred place. Please look around and let us know if you have any questions. We look forward to hosting you at Starseed Ranch soon!

 Dash & Erika Kuhr,
 Starseed Ranch Events

neighborhood_overview: Hawaiian Paradise Park, also referred to as Paradise Park and known by many as HPP, is a quiet neighborhood on the East side of the Island.  It is most known for it's beautiful cliffs and sunrises and it's convenient distances from Volcano, Hilo, the newest black sand beaches and much more!  Hawaiian Paradise Park is located around 20 minutes from the Hilo Airport.  It is in the heart of the lush green side of the Big Island of Hawaii.  At the bottom of the neighborhood are beautiful cliffs where you can hike or fish, right off of Beach road.  Shipman's beach is also at the bottom of the neighborhood, but requires an hour hike each way from the parking area.  To get there, take Kaloli Drive and drive to the end of the road and make a left.  Park your vehicle at the dead end.  See the Hawaiian Paradise Park Neighborhood Association's website for more information about the area.  Sometimes, when the volcano is active, you can see the lava glow from our neighborhood.

name: Private Bungalow (Hana Hale)
description: Tucked along the Kohala coast lies the beautifully secluded Starseed Ranch, only one mile from the breathtaking Pololū Valley. Surrounded by powerful ocean, lush jungle, fertile agriculture, and rushing streams, it’s the perfect place to reconnect with the land and center yourself in nature while enjoying modern comforts. Our 26-acre estate and organic farm is completely off-grid, run by hydroelectric and solar systems. We have several lodging options available, please see our other listings.
neighborhood_overview: We are in North Kohala, near historic Hawi and Kapa'au towns. This is a remote and culturally rich area with much to explore. Just a few minutes from the ranch, at the ‘end of the road’, lies the entrance to Pololu Valley. This spot is known as one of the most beautiful on Hawai’i Island. Visitors can hike down to the black sand beach and catch a glimpse into the first of seven valleys that make up the Hamakua and Kohala coastline. A breathtaking adventure not to be missed! Other nearby attractions include ocean beaches, snorkeling, hiking, eco-tour adventures, shopping, galleries, restaurants, farmers market, historical sites.
host_about:
We have been blessed to call North Kohala, Hawai'i home for over a decade. This is where we raise our family and run our farm and nonprofit, HIP Agriculture. As educators, we work with island youth around issues of food sovereignty, farmer training, and building resiliency. At Starseed Ranch under HIP ag,  we host farm field trips for local school groups and farmer training workshops.

Starseed Ranch has a vibrant history of sustainability and community, and we are honored to serve as stewards. This land has always held a special place in our hearts as we were married here in 2011, and have returned many times over the years to spend time with the previous owners, Jyoti and Andre. We have been hosting overnight lodging and special events since 2019,  and are excited to welcome more people to this beautiful and sacred place. Please look around and let us know if you have any questions. We look forward to hosting you at Starseed Ranch soon!

 Dash & Erika Kuhr,
 Starseed Ranch Events

neighborhood_overview: Overlooking Hanalei Bay was the plateau, which is now known as Princeville – a place of spiritual mana or power. neighborhood_overview: Hawaiian Paradise Park, also referred to as Paradise Park and known by many as HPP, is a quiet neighborhood on the East side of the Island. Hawaiian Paradise Park is located around 20 minutes from the Hilo Airport.  It is in the heart of the lush green side of the Big Island of Hawaii. * We would love to show you the mantas rays if you are an adventurous ocean lover. Inquire :)

description: Our house is in Ocean View, a rural area on the slopes of Mauna Loa. Expansive decks overlook the ocean below, from South Point north up the coast about 15 miles, & provide amazing sunset viewing. neighborhood_overview: Ocean View is a very large but not very densely populated area near South Point. If you Google it, you will get an idea of size and history.  It is a pretty rural area, with diverse landscape, from lava beds to more typical tropical feel Hawaii. It's over an hour's drive on a windy road to Kona, and about that to Volcano National Park. It's quiet, with starry nights and pleasant days, near Black Sand and Green Sand beaches, and South Point. Naalehu down the road about 20 minutes has an absolutely fantastic and famous bakery-- just far enough away so you're saved from daily impulsive bakery buys (but you can go get some and bring 'em back!) Weather is good here, not rainy like the Hilo side. Nearby Wood Valley has a coffee roaster and tasting shop, and a Buddhist temple, all in a lush setting. The Kahuku Unit of Volcano National Park is a 15 minute drive away, and has some nice hiking trails and a small visitor center.

host_about:
Born and raised in western Massachusetts, about as far away as one can possibly be from Hawai'i and still be in the United States, I arrived on O'ahu for a one-month vacation in 1980…but Hawai'i is hard to get out of one's system and I stayed to make Hawai'i my new home state. I’ve been exploring and loving the islands, people, and culture of Hawai'i for nearly four decades. I bought my first property on O'ahu in 1983, and during the 45-day escrow period, I earned my State of Hawai'i real estate license. Just two years later, I purchased the company I’d been working for; upon selling that business in 1986, I began and built my company, Fidelity Properties, from the ground up.  I purchased this beautiful (undeveloped) property in 1989 and built my home and the rental home and, over the years, I've nurtured the 'aina (land).  I enjoy swimming,  boating, and staying active.  Most importantly,  I am happy to share this paradise with you. 

Why this property?  "Keep the COUNTRY country."  You will see intermittent signs along the road on your way to the home.  The village of Waikane is in "the country"  away from the developed and more congested and populated areas of the island, and residents would like to keep it that way!  Here, there are flower farms and  and fruit trees.....a little bit of yesteryear and a country road that hugs the shoreline and takes you along an incredibly scenic drive along the windward coastline and onto the North Shore.  The quiet, windward side of O'ahu, from Kahuku to Kaneohe, is renowned for its lush vegetation, breezy trade winds, spectacular beaches, friendly little towns, and laid-back lifestyle.  With just about everything close at hand and several convenient avenues to Honolulu as well as the North Shore, it is no wonder I fell in love with and chose windward O'ahu, backdropped by the dramatic Ko'olau Mountain range, for my home and business base.  The nearest town is Kane'ohe, only a 15-minute drive, where you will find a variety of restaurants and shopping, a newly-expanded mall, movie theaters, and grocery stores.  

An acre of oceanfront, prettily landscaped with palm trees, flowers, and a lily pond, offers tranquility at the water's edge (the 'ae kai).....Sit and relax:  your view is the Chinaman's Hat sitting in the calm bay and the Ko'olau's rising steeply.  Forget your cares, feel anxiety slip away, savor the serenity.....

name: DHBH 1203 1 Bedroom Queen Suite on 12th floor
description:
Legal Vacation Rental - 2947 Kalakaua Ave #1203

My 12th floor Queen bed suite at The Diamond Head Beach Hotel & Residences is super close to the Ocean and nestled beneath the Diamond Head Crater, surrounded by the beautiful Kapiolani Park and perfect surfing locations. You’ll love the amazing ocean views and breezes. There's FREE WiFi included throughout our place, plus the comfortable spacious feel of the condo itself with its great kitchen.
neighborhood_overview:
The neighborhood is located at the base of Diamond Head, near the Waikiki Aquarium, across from Kapiolani Park, on the beautiful Pacific Ocean, and within walking distance of Waikiki and its attractions. Just beyond Waikiki at the base of Diamond Head is Honolulu’s “Gold Coast.”

The Gold Coast is the last strip of buildings at the end of Kalakaua Ave. across from Kapiolani Park. Unlike the “hustle and bustle” of Waikiki, the Gold Coast is a little more quiet.Right out the front doors of these buildings offer great swimming, diving, and surfing breaks such as Tongg’s, Rice Bowls, Old Man’s, and several others. You’ve also got Kapiolani Park on the Mauka (mountain side) as I mentioned, which is a great spot for outdoor activities and the finish line for the Honolulu Marathon, the Tinman Triathlon, etc.

Also the Diamond Head Beach Hotel is less than 2 buildings away from Private Clubs such as the Elk’s Club and the Outrigger Canoe Club.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

This unit is located in a peaceful cul-de-sac on Wilhelmina Rise; a residential neighborhood located in Honolulu, on the eastern side of the island of Oahu in Hawaii. The neighborhood is situated on a steep hillside, which offers residents panoramic views of the city and the ocean.

The area is named after Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands, who visited Hawaii in 1942 and was given a tour of the island by Governor Ingram Stainback. During her visit, she requested to see the view from the top of the hill, which was then named after her.

The development of the neighborhood began in the 1920s and continued through the 1950s. Today, Wilhelmina Rise is a desirable residential area with a mix of older homes and newer, larger houses. Many of the homes in the area have been renovated or rebuilt, and the neighborhood is known for its well-manicured lawns and gardens.

Lovingly restored, this vintage beauty features handsome oak floors, freshly painted paneled walls, original kitchen cabs and a lovely lanai to take in swoon-worthy sunsets.  Perched on the slopes of Hualalai, you'll escape the heat, hustle and bustle, without sacrificing proximity to shops, restaurants, the airport and HI’s best beaches. You’ll also escape all tourist traps for an authentic stay.
neighborhood_overview:
The neighborhood is authentic and perched on a hill, offering ocean views, balmy breezes and an ideal climate, so that no a/c is needed. A local market Matsuyamas is just down the street 2 minutes away. The airport, Costco and downtown are only 10 minutes away. Some of island's best beaches are only 15 minutes away!

Note that you may hear typical Hawaiian neighborhood noises like friendly animals such as dogs, chickens and roosters.
host_about:
Aloha!
We are thrilled be your helpful guides to our beautiful Hawaiian island! As you can see from our raving reviews, guests are loving their experiences staying with us just as much as we are enjoying them!  We are a professional team with backgrounds in education, law, and business and we love swapping our street suits for swimsuits to enjoy our favorite feature of Hawaii.  We are ocean fanatics who do our best to get in the water most days for a swim, snorkel, dive or surf. session.  We can't wait to share our ALOHA with you!

The house contains 3 bedrooms (2 queen and two bunk beds) and two bathrooms and can accommodate up 6 guests.

Grounds
A ¾ acre lot full of fruit trees seasonally oranges, mangos, papaya, avocado, lime, passion fruit, lemons, cherries and bread fruit.

host_about:
Waimanalo Beach Cottages  looking for beach goers and people who love the out doors and the appreciation for chilling. We are not a hotel. 

We offer 9 Cottages Perfect for large groups Minimum stay 7 nights.

Book all 9 cottages or just one cottage. 

Historical Waimanalo Beach Cottages is a beautiful country getaway. Steps from beautiful Waimanalo Beach where you see the incredible sunrise. 

We are in the in the tropics where you will find occasional ants, geckos and the salt air does create rust so quickly it is hard to keep up. There are also three cats and birds who reside on property. If you aren’t a fan of any of the above pease look elsewhere.

Our business is a Hawaii State Licensed vacation rental. We offer nine 
cottages that comfortably accommodate up to 24 guests. We have full-size kitchens that include the comforts of home with your family and friends. Our local grocery stores are nearby making your stay relaxed and affordable.

Our journey began over 60 years when Andrea Peters, mother, and grandmother purchased Waimanalo Beach Cottages, formerly known as Waimanalo Motel by a family who managed the Waimanalo sugar mill. At this time many military personals would vacation at the cottages with friends and relatives.

Once purchased, Waimanalo Beach Cottages were occupied by residents for long-term rentals. Within the last 15 years, Waimanalo Beach Cottages has transformed from residential rentals to vacation rentals, allowing our many visitors to enjoy our part of history and experience old Hawaii at its best.

So what makes us different?
Our family-run business has grown significantly over the years, but our commitment to giving you an extensive range of quality cottages at a good value hasn’t changed.

Our customer service with aloha brings our clients back time and time again, and for the holidays with large groups and events booked each year. I have to say “we must be getting something right”. 

Waimanalo Beach Cottages offers you Aloha. Each cottage in has been personally inspected and approved by our owners before your check-in. From breath-taking ocean views and landscapes, we offer something for everyone. Enjoy your Stay! We are in the tropics and you will find little critters especially if you leave food out.

Once purchased, Waimanalo Beach Cottages were occupied by residents for long-term rentals. Within the last 15 years, Waimanalo Beach Cottages has transformed from residential rentals to vacation rentals, allowing our many visitors to enjoy our part of history and experience old Hawaii at its best.

So what makes us different?
Our family-run business has grown significantly over the years, but our commitment to giving you an extensive range of quality cottages at a good value hasn’t changed.

Our customer service with aloha brings our clients back time and time again, and for the holidays with large groups and events booked each year. I have to say “we must be getting something right”. 

Waimanalo Beach Cottages offers you Aloha. Each cottage in has been personally inspected and approved by our owners before your check-in. From breath-taking ocean views and landscapes, we offer something for everyone. Enjoy your Stay! We are in the tropics and you will find little critters especially if you leave food out.

Amazing access to the best snorkeling and surfing in Kailua Kona, wake up and walk across to the beach. This large 1 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo has spectacular views and is in the perfect location to visit the beautiful Big Island, with a spacious great room, kitchen, laundry, a/c, private lanai overlooking the swimming pool, whirlpool spa and barbecue area and the ocean beyond. neighborhood_overview: Located in Keauhou which is on the south end of Kona town, with beaches, restaurants and shops nearby. Kahalu‘u Bay Beach Park is famous for it's snorkeling and surfing, on the south side the bay is super shallow and teaming with fish, sea turtles and coral while being sheltered by an ancient rock wall, on the north side the rock wall ends allowing the swell from the ocean to enter the bay creating a smooth and fun surfing wave even on small days. Snorkel rentals and surf lessons are available at the beach. Just a mile up the road to the north is the locally popular Magic Sands Beach with sugary white sand and a pretty massive body boarding wave that can slam you if your not careful. About a mile south is Keauhou Bay where many boating and swimming activities can be found.  Most of the snorkeling tours leave through Keauhou Bay and at night the Manta Rays do their feeding dance just outside the bay and it is spectacular to see.
host_about: We moved to the Big Island in 2013 to spend more time at Kahalu'u bay with the beautiful Hawaiian green sea turtles. Protecting and caring for our unique coral reef is our main motivation and sharing it's beauty and wonder with others makes us happy.

I have 5 horses, 4 are rescues, that I provide a loving, forever home for. Dogs, cats, and chickens roam freely, providing laughter and joy.
With family also living in Hawaii, the Big Island, I have an airbnb there, which I share with others, so they can enjoy it too.

description: Enjoy a prime location for an affordable price on the North Shore of Kaua'i above Hideaway beach and by Hotel One. host_about:
By far my all time favorite thing to do is to be a dad to my little boys. If only we could all have the awe and excitement they have for discovering the amazing universe we live in. I aspire to be open minded and I like to hang out with others that share that aspiration. As a host, I'd like to get to know my guests and do my best to be a good host that will make their stay better and more fun. I am always curious to meet world travelers from other countries.

name: Royal Palm Cottage
description: Situated on an 8.5 acre fruit farm along the Hamakua Coast, Royal Palm Cottage will provide you the  authentic feel of Hawaii country living.  As you enter the estate you will marvel at the breathtaking views of mature Royal Palms, Black Bamboo, ocean views and many other tropical Hawaiian flowers. Akaka Falls State park is 6 miles from us. A Boarding dog Kennel shares a portion of the property.   Barking can be heard 8 am-10am depending on season. It is Best if guests LOVE & understand DOGS.
neighborhood_overview: Located on the Big Island's lush and tropical Hamakua Coast, you can visit majestic  waterfalls all along the coast.  A quick  2.6 miles away is the town of Homomu which hosts Shark's Coffee Shop, Mr. Ed's Bakery and local eateries.  Just up the road is Akaka Falls State park, a majestic 440-foot waterfall with a short looped walking trail that will bring to it's base.  A short 15-minute drive will bring you to historic Hilo Town with unique restaurants and shopping.  Umauma Botanical Gardens and Zipline is a quick 1-mile jaunt away to test your adventurous nature.  The Hawaii volcanoes national Park is a one hour drive and the famous Hapuna beach is 75 minutes from the cottage.
host_about: I am born and raised in Hawaii.  Kalani and I love to travel the world and meet new people.  We wanted to share a bit of paradise with our guests. Hawaii is where we call home.  Dogs bark 8-10 am daily during feeding. Boarding kennel on property.(Smoking is allowed outside the cottage only.)

host_about:
Aloha! My name is Khoa Nguyen. I was born in Vietnam, but I spent most of my adolescent years in Portland, Oregon. I’ve traveled much of the United States, Europe, and the world for school and professional training, and am now excited to call Kona (Big Island) my home. I’ve decorated my home with a blend of the different cultural influences that I’ve experienced, which will ensure a warm and cozy stay.

On a professional level, I am a Doctor of Optometry and entrepreneur who loves to meet new people and to travel the world for humanitarian purposes. Over the past few years, I’ve teamed up with several student-led groups and medical mission organizations to provide community outreach, health screenings, and to host humanitarian events in Oregon, Vietnam, Belize, Honduras, and England. As an optometrist, I’m always strongly focused on providing the best care for my patients, and I will give the same care and attention as an Airbnb host for this home in beautiful Kailua-Kona.

Before booking, feel free to read the past reviews of my previous guests, and feel free to contact me if you have any questions about my listings. I’m always happy to provide information on places to see on this island.

WELCOME TO JEWEL OF KEOKEA MAUI

THINGS TO DO DURING YOUR STAY
You need much more than five perfect days to spend on Maui! But, if your time is short, you can choose from a long list of activities to enjoy a perfect island vacation.
Golden beaches give way to rolling hills and the misty mountain as you ascend into Upcountry Maui, which is located on the higher elevations surrounding Haleakala’s volcanic crater―Maui island’s highest peak.
Maui’s Upcountry area is comprised of Keokea, Kula, Makawao, Pukalani and Haliimaile. Each of these communities has its own distinct identity, making Upcountry Maui a diverse place to live and for visitors to explore.
From your doorstep in Keokea―a favorite among the local residents is Thompson Road―the best spot on Maui for an early morning jog or exhilarating walk. Begin with tea or coffee from Grandma's Coffee House, it’s about a 3-mile round trip with incredible vistas everywhere you look. Bordered by lush green pastures and historic lava rock walls, Thompso
host_about:
Welcome to Jewel of Keokea Guest-suite, a tranquil, contemporary design vacation full-suite with private entrance and patio garden in a private home in a friendly and local neighborhood―where a unique experience awaits you on the slopes of Maui’s Haleakala Mountain.
Within walking distance of a sleepy rural outpost, Keokea town is located in a uniquely beautiful region of the island at an elevation of 2,860 feet above sea level and is home to a splendid park, a gallery, country general store, an old-time gas station, two churches, and―the island’s landmark Grandma’s Coffee House which serves fresh baked goods, local cuisine and roasts its own Maui grown premier gourmet coffee.
Local residents and visitors alike find Keokea to be a hidden treasure tucked into the mountain landscape of the island. 
Jewel of Keokea offers a welcome alternative to hotel accommodation and gives you an authentic glimpse of Maui’s upcountry lifestyle while providing the ultimate contemporary short-term vacation experience. A private guest-suite with orchid garden offers a peaceful mountain getaway to plan your ultimate Maui vacation.

neighborhood_overview:
We've lived on the East Side of Kauai for 41 years, and still think it's the best side of the island. It has gorgeous beaches and hikes and is within an hour of both ends of the island, making the south, west and north shores easy to visit. I've left a book of suggestions in the condo, but will repeat some here....
1. Walk the glorious beach south of Lydgate State Park. You'll probably walk for at least a mile without seeing anyone else.
2. You have three choices for hiking the Sleeping Giant: walk up the east face, the west face or you can walk along the side of the mountain, through a bamboo forest.
3. Shop the stores in Kapaa Town, especially if you happen to be staying for the first Saturday night of the month, when the stores stay open late. There are food booths, entertainers and a hugely festive atmosphere to it all. I co-own one of the stores, KIKO. It's down a little alley on the main drag and very popular with tourists and locals alike. Not your usual tourist
host_about: I am an artist/designer (and former co-owner of a Sotheby's real estate company on Kauai, Hawaii).  I'm impulsive and a perfectionist -- a Virgo who is obsessed with making things look right (at least to my eye). I've been married to my husband, a retired pediatrician, for 51 years (yikes!). Yoga has been a big part of my life for the past thirty years, and I am certified to teach. We've traveled the world and fallen in love with many places, but  San Miguel  de Allende and Kauai, Hawaii came closest to perfection for me. They are my happy places, fulfilling my need to be around beaches, art, strong cultural traditions, indigenous people and perhaps most importantly, people who are kind to their children.

name: Private Bungalow (Coconut Hale)
description: Tucked along the Kohala coast lies the beautifully secluded Starseed Ranch, only one mile from the breathtaking Pololū Valley. Surrounded by powerful ocean, lush jungle, fertile agriculture, and rushing streams, it’s the perfect place to reconnect with the land and center yourself in nature while enjoying modern comforts. Our 26-acre estate is completely off-grid, run by hydroelectric and solar systems. We have several lodging options available, please see our other listings.
neighborhood_overview: We are in North Kohala, near historic Hawi and Kapa'au towns. This is a remote and culturally rich area with much to explore. Just a few minutes from the ranch, at the ‘end of the road’, lies the entrance to Pololu Valley. This spot is known as one of the most beautiful on Hawai’i Island. Visitors can hike down to the black sand beach and catch a glimpse into the first of seven valleys that make up the Hamakua and Kohala coastline. A breathtaking adventure not to be missed! Other nearby attractions include ocean beaches, snorkeling, hiking, eco-tour adventures, shopping, galleries, restaurants, farmers market, historical sites.
host_about:
We have been blessed to call North Kohala, Hawai'i home for over a decade. This is where we raise our family and run our farm and nonprofit, HIP Agriculture. As educators, we work with island youth around issues of food sovereignty, farmer training, and building resiliency. At Starseed Ranch under HIP ag,  we host farm field trips for local school groups and farmer training workshops.

Starseed Ranch has a vibrant history of sustainability and community, and we are honored to serve as stewards. This land has always held a special place in our hearts as we were married here in 2011, and have returned many times over the years to spend time with the previous owners, Jyoti and Andre. We have been hosting overnight lodging and special events since 2019,  and are excited to welcome more people to this beautiful and sacred place. Please look around and let us know if you have any questions. We look forward to hosting you at Starseed Ranch soon!

 Dash & Erika Kuhr,
 Starseed Ranch Events

description:

This quiet golf community of Waikoloa Village is nestled between the world-famous beaches of the resort coast and the shops and cooler weather of the town of Waimea.

neighborhood_overview:
Waikoloa is a quiet village about half an hour north of the Kona airport. Our house is across the street from a small local grocery store and a handful of restaurants. It is also a short drive from one of the largest shopping malls on the island. The volcanic summits of Mauna Loa, Mauna Kea, Kohala, Haleakalā on Maui, and Hualālai are all visible from our street. Besides the views, Waikoloa is known for its continuous sea breeze, popular beaches, and golf courses.

The Big Island mainly draws people interested in outdoor activities and wildlife. The island contains 10 of the world’s 14 biomes, so there is an incredible diversity of scenery and activities within a short distance of our house. There are lots of nearby opportunities for horseback riding, snorkeling, hiking, and wildlife viewing, especially of manta rays, sea turtles, and whales.

host_about:
A little bit about me...
I went all four years of high school in Paris, France. My time in Europe must have made an impression on me as my husband is from Holland.  I went from pharmaceutical and medical device sales to becoming a Zumba and fitness instructor.  My family and I are big into outdoor sports: tennis, hiking, biking, scuba diving (that's a sport, right?), you name it.  Adventure and outdoor activities were two of the main reasons fell in love with Kauai. 

About being an Airbnb guest and host...
I would have guessed something random like an in-flight cooking school had you asked me what Airbnb was 3 years ago.  Haha!  Today, it is a service that I cannot live without.  My husband and 2 daughters have enjoyed staying in Airbnb listings where we feel an owner would be proud and comfortable to stay themselves.  We enjoy having the comforts of our own kitchen, the travel tips provided and the incredible cost savings compared to nearby hotels. I don't want to be forced to tip Room Service for bringing me a bucket of ice, paying $6.00 for a tea bag and water or throwing away an expensive lunch because I don't have a fridge or dining room in my hotel room.    

We have taken those values and more and provided them for our own guests.  Our condo on the sunny shores of Kauai's famous Poipu Beach provides more than a stay.  It provides an experience.  We host as we would like to be hosted.  We offer extensive amenities, prompt communication, honesty, a welcome packet filled with activities and recommendations throughout Kauai.  We also welcome guest feedback in an effort to constantly improve.  I feel that our values and a passion for hosting others are reflected in our 5 star rating which awarded me Super Host status within the first 3 months of hosting. We would be honored to have you in our little slice of paradise.

host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

name: Tutu's Place a Volcano Village Cottage
description: Tutu's Place is a private home owned by Hawaii-born Lorna Larsen-Jeyte, the former co-owner of Kilauea Lodge. The 1,000 sq. ft (92m) cottage, is located in the heart of Volcano Village, 1 mile from Volcanoes Nat'l Park on a private lane with no through traffic. We can welcome up to 4 guests in 2 bedrooms (king bed, and one with a twin and double size bed). Enjoy a Jotul gas fireplace in your living room, a full kitchen, smart television for streaming and a large garden with outdoor dining table.
neighborhood_overview:
Hale Ohi'a Lane is a private cul-de-sac located in the very heart of Volcano Village walking distance to 6 restaurants, 2 small grocery stores, a laundromat, post office, and gas station. Native flora and fauna, unique to this altitude in Hawai'i, surround visitors, enhancing your serenity and connection with nature. The smells, sights and sounds reflect life in a slower, simpler time. Up the road is Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park, Volcano Golf Course, many galleries, hiking trails, and numerous other unique activities for all ages.
Hike anything at Volcano National Park and talk to the best park rangers for their latest recommendations!
Our family's favorite hike outside the national park is at Bird Park.
Get a handmade drinking glass at 2400 Faherenheit. See the latest work from local artists (ceramics, jewelry, paintings, wood carvings) by local artists at the Volcano Art Center. Visit the Volcano quilt shop for a traditional Hawaiian pattern or Ira Ono's in Hilo f
host_about:
My Dad Albert and Step-mom Lorna co-founded Kilauea Lodge a restaurant and inn. They "retired" and sold the Lodge in 2018 but kept four of the charming off-site properties as vacation rentals.  I'm helping them out by hosting these rentals.  I love to travel and want the places I stay to be clean, comfortable, and encourage long talks and laughter--just like our homes.  

I'm a "bookish" person and especially love cozying up on the couch with the fireplace going and reading contemporary fiction, mysteries, or historical fiction.  Reading has taught me so much about other people and their lives, loves, challenges, and victories. I am a mood reader, library lover, and don't have a problem DNFing (Did Not Finish) a book that's not for me. I've selected some of my favorite recent books for you to enjoy during your visit.  

“Let’s be reasonable and add an eighth day to the week that is devoted exclusively to reading.” – Lena Dunham

More...I also love walking in nature, photography, drinking coffee, cooking with my family, learning about different culture and traditions, tasting local food, watching tv (movies, sports, binge-watching a favorite series) and playing table games like Codenames, Dixit, and Ticket to Ride.  These are all things that you can do when you stay at one of our homes.  Volcano Village is one of my very favorite places in the world and I hope you come spend some time here!

name: Ola'a House in Volcano Village
description:
Ola'a (meaning "lively" in Hawaiian) House is a 1,700 square foot home in the heart of Volcano Village featuring vintage Hawaiian furnishings and original art. The house is owned and has been thoughtfully updated by the co-founder of Kilauea Lodge and former Magnum PI make-up artist Albert Jeyte (the house was part of the Kilauea Lodge properties.) We follow the Airbnb cleaning protocol.
STVR Registration number: STVR-19-358891
Nonconforming Use Certificate Number: NUC-19-1128
neighborhood_overview: Hale Ohi'a Lane is a private cul de sac located in the very heart of Volcano Village walking distance to 6 restaurants, 2 small grocery stores, a laundromat, post office, and gas station. Native flora and fauna, unique to this altitude in Hawai'i, surround visitors, enhancing your serenity and connection with nature. The smells, sights and sounds reflect life in a slower, simpler time. Up the road is Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park, Volcano Golf Course, many galleries, hiking trails, and numerous other unique activities for all ages.
host_about:
My Dad Albert and Step-mom Lorna co-founded Kilauea Lodge a restaurant and inn. They "retired" and sold the Lodge in 2018 but kept four of the charming off-site properties as vacation rentals.  I'm helping them out by hosting these rentals.  I love to travel and want the places I stay to be clean, comfortable, and encourage long talks and laughter--just like our homes.  

I'm a "bookish" person and especially love cozying up on the couch with the fireplace going and reading contemporary fiction, mysteries, or historical fiction.  Reading has taught me so much about other people and their lives, loves, challenges, and victories. I am a mood reader, library lover, and don't have a problem DNFing (Did Not Finish) a book that's not for me. I've selected some of my favorite recent books for you to enjoy during your visit.  

“Let’s be reasonable and add an eighth day to the week that is devoted exclusively to reading.” – Lena Dunham

More...I also love walking in nature, photography, drinking coffee, cooking with my family, learning about different culture and traditions, tasting local food, watching tv (movies, sports, binge-watching a favorite series) and playing table games like Codenames, Dixit, and Ticket to Ride.  These are all things that you can do when you stay at one of our homes.  Volcano Village is one of my very favorite places in the world and I hope you come spend some time here!

Location
Located in the heart of old Wailuku Town, just ten minutes from the airport. This location is perfect for folks who plan on exploring all around Maui (something I suggest no matter where you stay!) It’s also worlds away in attitude and experience from the touristy hotels and resorts.

Wailuku is the capital town of Maui; completely non-touristy and down to earth. Compared to mainland cities, Wailuku is a sleepy laid-back small town, a throwback to much simpler times. In recent years Wailuku has seen a resurgence, with an eclectic array of hip shops and restaurants opening up alongside old-time Maui standards. You can walk all of Wailuku Town from this very central location.

host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

Aloha Kai Properties is a family business. Deborah D. Sharp, “AlohaDebbie” started her family on the Big Island over 40 years ago. We are a happy, loving family (Ohana) of five children in Love (aloha) with the Ocean (kai). Leilani was born in Kealakekua and her younger brother, Joseph Talman, who goes by “Tally” was born in Hilo. Both have a passion for the water. Leilani is an avid paddler and Tally loves to surf. Together, Leilani and Debbie have managed vacation rentals since 1995.  Tally joined in 2017. Leilani Properties & Aloha Kai Properties have a handful of high quality vacation homes, or as we say in Hawaiian “Na Hale Pono” – just the best! Our goal has always been to carry the spirit of aloha into our beautiful vacation homes and to the people who visit them. Our properties are well maintained and full of charm, beauty and comfort.

host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

neighborhood_overview: Poʻipū Beach Park is located in the community of Poʻipū on the southern coast of Kauaʻi island in Hawaii. The beach is a park has lifeguards provided by the county of Kauaʻi.
host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.

neighborhood_overview:
Papaaloa is a coastal community southeast of Weloka and northwest of Ninole on the Hamakua Coast. Like many of the neighboring villages along this eastern shoreline, Papaaloa was once an integral part of the sugar cane industry on the Big Island. The village has since evolved into quiet neighborhoods along the main highway and nearby side roads. A general store and post office are available in Papaaloa, and an airport, grocery stores, and other amenities are available in Hilo 18 miles south.

The sunrises along the Hamakua Coast are a wonder to behold, and Papaaloa is a great place for whale watching during certain months of the year. Streams run through Papaaloa, and the climate sustains lush rainforest and a wide range of vegetation and fruit trees. The region receives 120 inches of rainfall per year, and average temperatures range from the mid 60’s to 80’s Fahrenheit year-round.

With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

name: Garden of the Phoenix
description: Garden of the Phoenix is a 2 bed/1 bath, upstairs unit with a lanai facing State Land, 100s of acres of native Ohia Forest, the first tree to sprout and grow on freshly cooled lava. It is about 1.5 mies from  Kehena Black Sand Beach where wild dolphins sometimes swim and beach goers host a Sunday drum circle. The neighborhood has a Dark Sky policy to promote star gazing. Uncle Robert’s offers a variety of Farmer’s Markets and evening music with a bar, smoothie shack and convenience store.
neighborhood_overview:
Kehena Beach is a clothing optional black sand beach where wild dolphins may swim with beach goers. Spearfisher men also frequent the spot. About 1.5 miles away.

Biking along highway 137,the ocean is idyllic with many beautiful places to ocean gaze and some secret beaches, lava tubes and tide pools.

Pohoiki, aka Issac Hale Park is one of the world’s newest black sand beaches where you can witness the incredible destruction and creation from the 2018 lava irruption.

Travel further to Kopoho for more fresh lava adventure and black sand beaches. Marvel at the new road built over fresh lava and look mauka (toward the mountain) from makai (toward the ocean) and see the cinder cones in Leilani Estates.

Fissure 8 is a spectacle.

Uncle Robert’s on Wednesday nights is live music, open bar with tons of food and trinket vendors. About 4 miles away.

Kalani offers some fun classes, massages and has a pool and hot tubs and a deli.
host_about:
Aloha, I have lived in Hawaii for over 12 years, mostly in Puna on Big Island, a 2.5 years in Waikiki. I love hosting people from around the world to explore the most active volcano on the planet or the Playground of the Pacific, aka, Honolulu. I work full time as a carpenter and realtor. I was a massage therapist for 10 years. I have a strong interest in architecture and agriculture, utility systems, business and engineering.

host_about:
Suite Paradise – The gateway to island living.

Suite Paradise in sunny Poipu Beach on Kauai is home to hundreds of vacation rental properties, amenable to any sized group and any specifications you could think of. With the highest level of service and a wide range of vacation rental options, Suite Paradise can ensure that your stay is as seamless as Kauai’s lifestyle.

Choose from luxurious beach resorts, each with multiple pools and spas within walking distance and top-of-the-line amenities, including, but not limited to, full membership to Poipu Beach Athletic Club for the duration of your stay. Poipu Kai consists of 70 acres of lush tropical foliage and some of Kauai’s most sought-after vacation rentals. One complex is literally located nestled in a verdant and extinct volcano crater – you can’t get more immersed in the island lifestyle than that! From mauka (mountain) to makai (sea), Suite Paradise has something for you!

Kahala – A popular complex that is home to mostly one- and two-bedroom units. Kahala is only a short walk from the beach, and closest to Poipu Kai’s tennis courts and Kalapaki Joe’s sports bar. With the option of both mountain and ocean views available dependent on the unit, Kahala’s location is perfectly situated with proximity to Poipu Road as well as the Poipu Kai greenbelt.

Makanui – Two- and three-bedroom units perched across from Poipu Crater, with stunning mountain views, distant ocean views, and a short walk to the greenbelt path.

Manualoha –Less than a mile from the beach, although the complex pool is practically attached to the Pacific Ocean! With units sleeping four to six, easy access to the greenbelt pathway, and hues of purple bougainvillea draped throughout the complex.

Poipu Sands – One- and two-bedroom units with incredible ocean views, spacious lanais, and a short walk to Shipwreck’s Beach.

Regency – Larger units, spacious enough to accommodate up to 10 guests. Many of these units are newly remodeled and offer AC. Regency and Kahala sit right next to each other.

Regency Villas – Luxury units with central AC. Regency Villas often feature a loft and sleep up to five guests. Situated near the greenbelt for easy access to many resort amenities, and centrally located for a short walk to Brennecke's Beach, or access to the Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort.

Nihi Kai Villas - A comfortable and quiet beach resort with 70 condos to choose from. Located right across from the ocean.

Poipu Crater – Just as the name says, Poipu Crater is nestled in a verdant an extinct volcano crater, which makes the foliage truly breathtaking. With 30 condos to choose from, sleeping four to six guests, the choice is yours! Enjoy the tropical gardens and central location to all that Poipu has to offer.

Lawai Beach Resort - Luxurious oceanfront condos located directly across from arguably the best snorkeling spot on the island. Enjoy a short stroll to five-star dining at The Beach House or enjoy the view from Lawai Beach, as the surfers paddle out for a sunset session. With room to sleep up to six, Lawai Beach Resort has it all!

Poipu Kapili - A beautiful and peaceful resort located on five acres of meticulously landscaped oceanfront property.

Pili Mai - This is Kauai’s newest resort development of luxury condominiums, nestled among a championship golf course.
